The choice of the right dog should be based on the adopter's lifestyle and the animal's needs, seeking compatibility and harmony. Foundations and animal shelters offer guidance and support throughout the process, ensuring the best possible union between the new owner and their companion. It's a long-term commitment that provides unconditional companionship and affection, filling the home with joy and new experiences.

text_es: When I decided to adopt a dog, I felt a mix of excitement and nervousness. I spent months researching breeds and shelters, seeking the companionship and love I longed for. Finally, I found Lucas, a 2-year-old mixed breed with big eyes and soft, shiny fur. The adoption process was economical and quick: we filled out forms and they interviewed me, checking my stability and responsibility. From the first day, Lucas brought joy and a certain controversy into my life, with his barks and his playfulness. His walks and naps are now the center of my daily life, and every afternoon we share affection and glances. His presence taught me about patience and loyalty, and the fact that I have this daily contact with him, the connection and affection I feel are indescribable, worth more than any bonus.
text_tgt_raw: Quando decidi adotar um cachorro, senti uma mistura de empolgação e nervosismo. Passei meses pesquisando raças e abrigos, buscando a companhia e o amor que tanto ansiava. Finalmente, encontrei Lucas, um vira-lata de 2 anos com olhos grandes e pelo macio e brilhante. O processo de adoção foi econômico e rápido: preenchemos formulários e me entrevistaram, verificando minha estabilidade e responsabilidade. Desde o primeiro dia, Lucas trouxe alegria e uma certa polêmica para a minha vida, com seus latidos e suas brincadeiras. Seus passeios e suas sonecas agora são o centro do meu dia a dia, e toda tarde compartilhamos carinhos e olhares. Sua presença me ensinou sobre paciência e lealdade, e o fato de ter esse contato diário com ele, a conexão e o afeto que sinto são indescritíveis, valendo mais que qualquer bônus.
base_en: When I decided to adopt a dog, I felt a mix of excitement and nerves. I had spent months researching breeds and shelters, looking for the companionship and love I longed for so much. Finally, I found Lucas, a 2-year-old mixed breed with big eyes and soft, shiny fur. The adoption process was simple and quick: we filled out forms and they interviewed me, checking my stability and responsibility. From the 1st day, Lucas brought joy and chaos into my life, with his barks and his games. His walks and his naps are now the center of my daily life, and every afternoon we share cuddles and glances. His presence has taught me about patience and loyalty, and the connection and affection I feel for him are indescribable.

text_es: Adopting a dog is a commitment that requires time and dedication, so research breeds and their exercise and care needs thoroughly. Before bringing him home, prepare a comfortable space with his bed and toys, and make sure food and water are available. In the first few days, establish a clear routine for walks and feeding, helping him adapt. Early socialization with other dogs and people is key for his good development and behavior, especially if you plan to travel by bus or train with him. Patience and positive reinforcement are essential tools for his education and learning. Don't forget regular vet visits for check-ups and vaccinations, as well as his registration. Enjoy this new phase of love and companionship, forging a strong and lasting bond.
text_tgt_raw: Adotar um cachorro é um fato que exige tempo e dedicação, então pesquise bem as raças e suas necessidades de exercícios e cuidados. Antes de trazê-lo para casa, prepare um espaço cômodo com sua caminha e brinquedos, e certifique-se de que há comida e água disponíveis. Nos primeiros dias, estabeleça uma rotina clara para passeios e alimentação, ajudando-o a se adaptar. A socialização precoce com outros cães e pessoas é chave para seu bom desenvolvimento e comportamento, especialmente se você planejar viajar de ônibus ou trem com ele. Paciência e reforço positivo são ferramentas essenciais para sua educação e aprendizado. Não se esqueça das visitas regulares ao veterinário para check-ups e vacinas, além do seu registro. Aproveite essa nova fase de amor e companheirismo, forjando um laço forte e duradouro.
base_en: Adopting a dog is an important decision that requires time and commitment, so research breeds and their exercise and care needs well. Before bringing it home, prepare an adequate space with its bed and toys, and make sure you've food and water available. During the 1st days, establish a clear routine for walks and feeding to help it adapt. Early socialization with other dogs and people is key for its good development and behavior. Patience and positive reinforcement are essential tools for its education and learning. Don't forget regular visits to the vet for check-ups and vaccinations, as well as its identification and registration. Enjoy this new stage of love and companionship, forging a strong and lasting bond.

text_es: Assembling a shelf is a common task in many homes and offices, offering an economical and practical solution for storage and organization. For a task like this, patience and precision are needed, in addition to the correct tools and materials to ensure its stability and durability. Before starting, it is essential to review the instructions and check if all necessary parts and hardware, such as screws and nuts, are present. The process usually involves joining side and horizontal panels, firmly attaching each component to prevent movement and instability. Often, a drill and a screwdriver are needed to complete the assembly safely and efficiently. Correct installation ensures that the shelf can support the weight of books and decorative objects without risk. Although not as fun as a sport, at the end of assembly, it is recommended to check the stability and levelness of the structure. Contacting the manufacturer's manual is crucial. If you need a replacement part, you might have to take a bus or even a train to go to the store. To avoid frustration, planning is essential.
text_tgt_raw: Montar uma prateleira é uma tarefa comum em muitas casas e escritórios, oferecendo uma solução econômica e prática para armazenamento e organização. Para um fato como esse, é preciso paciência e precisão, além das ferramentas e materiais corretos para garantir sua estabilidade e durabilidade. Antes de começar, é essencial revisar as instruções e verificar se todas as peças e ferragens necessárias, como parafusos e porcas, estão presentes. O processo geralmente envolve a união de painéis laterais e horizontais, fixando cada componente firmemente para evitar movimento e instabilidade. Frequentemente, uma furadeira e uma chave de fenda são necessárias para completar a montagem de forma segura e eficiente. A instalação correta garante que a prateleira possa suportar o peso de livros e objetos decorativos sem risco. Embora não seja tão divertido quanto um esporte, ao final da montagem, recomenda-se verificar a estabilidade e o nivelamento da estrutura. Um contato com o manual do fabricante é crucial. Se precisar de uma peça de reposição, talvez seja preciso pegar um ônibus ou até um trem para ir à loja. Para evitar frustrações, o planejamento é fundamental.
base_en: Assembling a shelf is a common task in many homes and offices, offering a practical solution for storage and organization. It requires patience and precision, as well as the right tools and materials to ensure its stability and durability. Before starting, it's essential to review the assembly instructions and verify that all necessary parts and hardware, such as screws and nuts, are present. The process generally involves joining side and horizontal panels, firmly attaching each component to prevent movement and wobbling. Often, a drill and a screwdriver are needed to complete the assembly safely and efficiently. Correct installation ensures that the shelf can support the weight of books and decorative objects without risk. Once assembly is finished, it's recommended to check the stability and leveling of the structure.

text_es: Last week, I embarked on the mission of assembling a bookshelf in the living room, a true project of patience and manual skills. Upon opening the box, the quantity of pieces and screws, along with the confusing instructions and diagrams, already caused me some stress. The first step was to separate the wood and hardware, and that's when I realized I was missing a screwdriver and a hammer, essential tools I didn't have on hand. The process of fitting the shelves and supports proved to be more complex than I expected, with some last-minute errors and corrections, a fact that made me laugh later. After three hours of effort and concentration, and with a little help and encouragement from my partner, the bookshelf was finally standing, now displaying my books and mementos. I felt great satisfaction and pride in the final result, a project that, despite the challenges, was quite economical and made me feel like a true builder. I connected my cell phone to listen to music and the experience became even more pleasant.
text_tgt_raw: Na semana passada, embarquei na missão de montar uma estante na sala, um verdadeiro projeto de paciência e habilidades manuais. Ao abrir a caixa, a quantidade de peças e parafusos, junto com as instruções e desenhos confusos, já me causou um certo estresse. O primeiro passo foi separar a madeira e as ferragens, e foi aí que percebi a falta de uma chave de fenda e um martelo, ferramentas essenciais que não tinha à mão. O processo de encaixar as prateleiras e suportes se mostrou mais complexo do que eu esperava, com alguns erros e correções de última hora, um fato que me fez rir depois. Após três horas de esforço e concentração, e com um pouco de ajuda e encorajamento da minha parceira, a estante finalmente estava de pé, exibindo agora meus livros e recordações. Senti uma grande satisfação e orgulho do resultado final, um projeto que, apesar dos desafios, foi bastante econômico e me fez sentir como um verdadeiro construtor. Conectei meu celular para ouvir música e a experiência ficou ainda mais agradável.
base_en: Last week, I set out to assemble a bookshelf in the living room, a true DIY and patience project. Upon opening the box, the number of pieces and screws, as well as the confusing instructions and drawings, already generated some stress and exhaustion for me. The 1st thing was to sort the wood and hardware, then I realized I was missing a screwdriver and a hammer, essential tools I didn't have on hand. The process of fitting the boards and supports together turned out to be more complex than I anticipated, with a few errors and last-minute corrections. After 3 hours of effort and concentration, and with a little help and encouragement from my partner, the bookshelf finally stood upright. Now it displays books and souvenirs, and I feel proud and satisfied with the final result.

text_es: When assembling a bookshelf, patience and organization are key to a durable and convenient result. Before starting, it's a fact that you should check if you have all the necessary parts and tools – screwdrivers and Allen wrenches, for example – and carefully read the assembly instructions and diagrams, thus avoiding a phenomenon of later errors. Identify and classify the screws and dowels, as well as the different panels and shelves, to avoid confusion. Good fastening and leveling are fundamental for the stability and safety of the furniture, so take your time with each step. If it's a large bookshelf, planning and the help of another person can make the job much more economical in terms of time and effort. Carefully check the joints and fastenings before loading books and decorative objects.
text_tgt_raw: Ao montar uma estante, paciência e organização são a chave para um resultado duradouro e cômodo. Antes de começar, é um fato que você deve verificar se tem todas as peças e ferramentas necessárias – chaves de fenda e chaves Allen, por exemplo – e ler atentamente as instruções e diagramas de montagem, evitando assim um fenômeno de erros posteriores. Identifique e classifique os parafusos e buchas, bem como os diferentes painéis e prateleiras, para não gerar confusão. Uma boa fixação e nivelamento são fundamentais para a estabilidade e segurança do móvel, então leve seu tempo em cada etapa. Se for uma estante grande, o planejamento e a ajuda de outra pessoa podem tornar o trabalho muito mais econômico em termos de tempo e esforço. Verifique cuidadosamente as junções e fixações antes de carregar livros e objetos decorativos.
base_en: When assembling a bookshelf, patience, and organization are key for a successful and lasting result. Before starting, verify that you've all the necessary parts and tools—screwdrivers and Allen wrenches, for example—and carefully read the assembly instructions and diagrams. Identify and classify the screws and anchors, as well as the different panels and shelves, to avoid confusion and errors. Good screwing and leveling are fundamental for the stability and safety of the furniture, so take your time with each step. If it's a large bookshelf, the help and support of another person can make the job much easier and faster. Carefully check the joints and fastenings before loading books and decorative objects.

text_es: Saving for vacation is a smart financial strategy that allows you to enjoy a well-deserved rest without worries and economic stress. This involves advance planning and discipline, establishing a clear budget that includes transportation, accommodation, food, and activity expenses. It is recommended to set a savings goal and a realistic deadline, evaluating monthly income and expenses to identify where superfluous expenses can be reduced, such as cutting down on restaurant visits or avoiding impulse purchases, and thus increasing funds for the trip. Creating a specific savings account can help separate this money from daily finances and avoid temptations, ensuring that the time and money invested are worthwhile. Furthermore, looking for offers and promotions in advance can significantly reduce the cost of tickets and hotels, expanding the possibilities and destinations of the experience. This way, adventure and relaxation will be within reach, without compromising personal and family financial stability, whether for a train trip or a quick bus trip.
text_tgt_raw: Economizar para as férias é uma estratégia financeira inteligente que possibilita desfrutar de um merecido descanso sem preocupações e estresse econômico. Isso envolve planejamento e disciplina antecipados, estabelecendo um orçamento claro que inclua transporte, hospedagem, alimentação e gastos com atividades. É recomendado definir uma meta de poupança e um prazo realista, avaliando a renda e as despesas mensais para identificar onde gastos supérfluos podem ser reduzidos, como diminuir as idas a restaurantes ou evitar compras por impulso, e assim aumentar os fundos para a viagem. Criar uma conta poupança específica pode ajudar a separar esse dinheiro das finanças diárias e evitar tentações, garantindo que o tempo e o dinheiro investidos valham a pena. Além disso, procurar ofertas e promoções com antecedência pode reduzir significativamente os custos de passagens e hotéis, expandindo as possibilidades e destinos da experiência. Dessa forma, a aventura e o relaxamento estarão ao alcance, sem comprometer a estabilidade financeira pessoal e familiar, seja para uma viagem de trem ou um bate e volta de ônibus.
base_en: Saving for vacation is a smart financial strategy that allows you to enjoy a well-deserved rest without financial worries and stress. It involves advance planning and discipline, establishing a clear budget that includes transportation and accommodation, food, and activity expenses. It's recommended to set a savings goal and a realistic deadline, evaluating monthly income and expenses to identify areas where superfluous expenses can be reduced and funds for the trip can be increased. Creating a specific savings account can help separate this money from daily finances and avoid temptations, ensuring that the money and time invested in saving pay off. In addition, looking for offers and promotions in advance can significantly reduce the costs of flights and hotels, expanding the possibilities and destinations of the experience. In this way, adventure, and relaxation will be within reach, without compromising personal and family financial stability.

text_es: Last year, I remember the excitement and frustration I felt trying to save for my summer vacation. My plan was to travel to Galicia, explore its coasts and cities, so I needed to save the money and time required for it. I started cutting expenses on whims and outings, choosing to cook at home instead of going to restaurants or the movies. Every cent and euro I didn't spend went directly into a piggy bank, where I collected bills and coins. I also reviewed my subscriptions and services, canceling those I barely used and looking for deals and discounts on everything. I remember taking the bus a few times instead of a taxi to be more economical. In the end, the effort and discipline paid off; I was able to enjoy 10 wonderful days, full of adventures and landscapes, a fact that made me very happy. It was a lesson in planning and perseverance that I won't easily forget, and the contact with nature and new experiences were an incredible bonus. I didn't even need to use my cell phone much, that's how much I was enjoying every moment. Breakfast was always a special time.
text_tgt_raw: No ano passado, lembro-me da emoção e da frustração que senti ao tentar economizar para minhas férias de verão. Meu plano era viajar para a Galícia, explorar suas costas e cidades, então precisei juntar o dinheiro e o tempo necessários para isso. Comecei a cortar gastos com caprichos e passeios, optando por cozinhar em casa em vez de ir a restaurantes ou ao cinema. Cada centavo e euro que eu não gastava ia diretamente para um cofrinho, onde acumulava notas e moedas. Também revisei minhas assinaturas e serviços, cancelando aqueles que mal usava e procurando ofertas e descontos em tudo. Lembro-me de ter pego o ônibus algumas vezes em vez de táxi para ser mais econômico. No final, o esforço e a disciplina valeram a pena; pude desfrutar de 10 dias maravilhosos, cheios de aventuras e paisagens, um fato que me deixou muito feliz. Foi uma lição de planejamento e perseverança que não vou esquecer facilmente, e o contato com a natureza e as novas experiências foram um bônus incrível. Nem precisei usar muito meu celular, de tanto que estava aproveitando cada momento. O café da manhã era sempre um momento especial.
base_en: I remember the excitement and frustration I felt last year trying to save for my summer vacation. My plan was to travel to Galicia, explore its coasts and towns, so I needed to get the money and time necessary to make it happen. I started to cut down on expenses for whims and outings, choosing to cook at home instead of going to restaurants and movie theaters. Every cent and euro I didn't spend went directly into a piggy bank, where I accumulated bills and coins. I also reviewed my subscriptions and services, canceling those I barely used and looking for offers and discounts on everything. In the end, the effort and discipline were worth it; I was able to enjoy 10 wonderful days, full of adventures and landscapes. It was a lesson in planning and perseverance that I won't easily forget.

text_es: To start saving for vacation, discipline and organization are essential. Create a detailed budget that includes your income and expenses, looking for areas where you can reduce superfluous costs and unnecessary leisure. Think about your travel priorities and set a realistic and achievable savings goal. Consider opening a separate savings account, exclusively for travel, to avoid the temptation of spending that money on other things or unexpected expenses. Small changes in your daily habits and even big sacrifices can make a huge difference; for example, preparing your food at home instead of eating out can result in significant savings, or even taking a bus instead of a taxi. Avoiding spending on items like a daily ice cream or swapping that bakery breakfast for something made at home are things that help. Remember that consistency and patience are key to achieving your dreams of adventure and relaxation.
text_tgt_raw: Para começar a economizar para as férias, é essencial ter disciplina e organização. Crie um orçamento detalhado que inclua sua renda e suas despesas, buscando áreas onde você possa reduzir custos supérfluos e lazer desnecessário. Pense nas suas prioridades de viagem e estabeleça uma meta de poupança realista e atingível. Considere abrir uma conta poupança separada, exclusivamente para viagens, evitando a tentação de gastar esse dinheiro com outras coisas ou despesas inesperadas. Pequenas mudanças em seus hábitos diários e até mesmo grandes sacrifícios podem fazer uma enorme diferença; por exemplo, preparar sua comida em casa em vez de comer fora pode render uma economia bem econômica, ou até mesmo pegar um ônibus em vez de um táxi. Evitar gastos com itens como um sorvete diário ou trocar aquele café da manhã na padaria por algo feito em casa são fatos que ajudam. Lembre-se que consistência e paciência são a chave para alcançar seus sonhos de aventura e relaxamento.
base_en: To start saving for vacation, it's essential to have discipline and organization. Create a detailed budget that includes your income and expenses, and look for areas where you can reduce superfluous costs and unnecessary leisure. Think about your travel priorities and goals and set a realistic and achievable savings goal. Consider opening a separate savings account, exclusively for travel, so you'll avoid the temptation to spend that money on other things and unforeseen expenses. Small changes in your daily habits and big sacrifices can make a big difference; for example, preparing your food at home instead of eating out will save you a good amount of money. Remember that consistency and patience are key to achieving your dreams of adventure and relaxation.

text_es: Learning a new language is an enriching experience that opens doors to new cultures and professional opportunities. It requires dedication and effort, but the benefits are immense and long-lasting. It is a fact that it requires constant practice in grammar and vocabulary, in addition to immersion in daily conversation and listening. Many students use online resources and in-person classes to improve their skills and confidence. It is crucial to plan realistic goals and maintain motivation, as the process can be challenging but very rewarding. Patience and perseverance are the key to success in this academic journey. This process not only improves communicative and cognitive skills but also promotes a greater understanding and appreciation for global diversity, whether on a bus, train, or even using a cell phone.
text_tgt_raw: Aprender um novo idioma é uma experiência enriquecedora que abre portas para novas culturas e oportunidades profissionais. Exige dedicação e esforço, mas os benefícios são imensos e duradouros. É um fato que requer prática constante em gramática e vocabulário, além de imersão na conversação e escuta diárias. Muitos estudantes utilizam recursos online e aulas presenciais para aprimorar suas habilidades e confiança. É crucial planejar metas realistas e manter a motivação, pois o processo pode ser desafiador, mas muito gratificante. Paciência e perseverança são a chave para o sucesso nesta jornada acadêmica. Esse processo não apenas melhora as habilidades comunicativas e cognitivas, mas também promove uma maior compreensão e apreciação pela diversidade global, seja em um ônibus, trem ou até mesmo usando o celular.
base_en: Learning a new language is an enriching experience that opens doors to new cultures and professional opportunities. It involves dedication and effort, but the benefits are immense and long-lasting. It requires constant practice in grammar and vocabulary, as well as immersion in daily speaking and listening. Many students utilize online resources and in-person classes to improve their skills and confidence. It's crucial to set realistic goals and maintain motivation, as the process can be challenging but rewarding. Patience and perseverance are key to success in this educational journey. This process not only improves communicative and cognitive skills, but also fosters a greater understanding and appreciation for global diversity.

text_es: I vividly remember when I started learning Japanese, about two years ago. In the beginning, it was a total chaos of sounds and symbols. The kanji and grammar seemed like an insurmountable barrier, a true phenomenon. My friends and family encouraged me, but frustration and exhaustion were constant. However, with time and effort—I dedicated about two hours daily—words and phrases started to make sense. Now I can watch movies and series without subtitles, and even have simple conversations with natives, which is a fact that brings me great joy and satisfaction. It's a fascinating journey of discovery and personal growth, and every day I find new words and expressions, which is very rewarding. Often, I would go to Japanese class by bus, and during the trip, I would use my cell phone to review vocabulary. I even planned my study to be economical in terms of time and effort.
text_tgt_raw: Lembro-me vivamente de quando comecei a aprender japonês, há uns dois anos. No início, era um caos total de sons e símbolos. Os kanjis e a gramática pareciam uma barreira intransponível, um verdadeiro fenômeno. Meus amigos e família me incentivavam, mas a frustração e o cansaço eram constantes. No entanto, com tempo e esforço – eu dedicava cerca de duas horas diárias – as palavras e frases começaram a fazer sentido. Agora consigo assistir a filmes e séries sem legendas, e até mesmo ter conversas simples com nativos, o que é um fato que me traz grande alegria e satisfação. É uma jornada fascinante de descoberta e crescimento pessoal, e a cada dia encontro novas palavras e expressões, o que é muito gratificante. Muitas vezes, eu ia para a aula de japonês de ônibus, e durante a viagem, usava meu celular para revisar o vocabulário. Eu até planejava meu estudo para que fosse econômico em termos de tempo e esforço.
base_en: I vividly remember when I started learning Japanese about 2 years ago. At 1st, it was a total chaos of sounds and symbols. The kanji and grammar seemed like an insurmountable barrier, a true mountain and valley of knowledge. My friends and family encouraged me, but frustration and exhaustion were constant. However, with time and effort—I dedicated about 2 hours daily—words and phrases started to make sense. Now I enjoy movies and series without subtitles, and I can even hold simple conversations and debates with natives, a great joy and satisfaction. It's a fascinating journey of discovery and personal growth, and every day I find new words and expressions, which is very gratifying.

text_es: To learn a new language, consistency and patience are, in fact, fundamental. From day one, immerse yourself in the language through study and active practice. Look for resources and tools like apps, books, movies, and music that expose you to the language regularly. Don't be afraid to make mistakes; they are a natural part of the learning process and will help you improve your comprehension and expression. Finding an exchange partner or joining conversation groups is valuable contact for practicing communication and gaining confidence. Remember that immersion and fun are essential for maintaining long-term motivation, whether watching a sports game or listening to music. Set realistic goals and celebrate every small achievement and step forward in your journey, perhaps with some delicious ice cream. Even on the bus, you can take the opportunity to review vocabulary on your cell phone.
text_tgt_raw: Para aprender um novo idioma, consistência e paciência são, de fato, fundamentais. Desde o primeiro dia, mergulhe na língua através de estudo e prática ativa. Procure recursos e ferramentas como aplicativos, livros, filmes e músicas que o exponham ao idioma regularmente. Não tenha medo de cometer erros; eles são uma parte natural do processo de aprendizado e o ajudarão a melhorar sua compreensão e expressão. Encontrar um parceiro de intercâmbio ou participar de grupos de conversação é um contato valioso para praticar a comunicação e ganhar confiança. Lembre-se que a imersão e a diversão são essenciais para manter a motivação a longo prazo, seja assistindo a um jogo de esporte ou ouvindo uma música. Estabeleça metas realistas e celebre cada pequena conquista e passo à frente em sua jornada, talvez com um delicioso sorvete. Até mesmo no ônibus, você pode aproveitar para revisar o vocabulário no seu celular.
base_en: To learn a new language, consistency, and patience are key. From day 1, immerse yourself in the language through study and active practice. Look for resources and tools such as apps, books, movies, and music that expose you to the language regularly. Don't be afraid to make mistakes; they're a natural part of the learning process and will help you improve your comprehension and expression. Find an exchange partner or join conversation groups to practice communication and gain confidence. Remember that immersion and fun are essential for maintaining long-term motivation. Set realistic goals and celebrate every small achievement and step forward on your journey.

text_es: Participating in a popular race is a phenomenon, a true sport that attracts people of all levels and ages, promoting well-being and social contact. Generally, these races offer varied distances, such as 5 km, 10 km, or even half marathons, and often cover scenic urban or natural landscapes, transforming into a celebration of effort. For a good experience, it is crucial to plan physical preparation and race strategy, in addition to staying hydrated. Interestingly, many of these events have a social component: part of the registration fee is donated to charity organizations, which adds even greater value to participation. Furthermore, the act of running side-by-side with other supporters and enthusiasts creates a sense of community. The festive atmosphere, camaraderie, and pride of crossing the finish line, regardless of position or time, make this experience unique and memorable, surpassing the daily use of a cell phone or the simple act of taking a bus.
text_tgt_raw: Participar de uma corrida popular é um fenômeno, um verdadeiro esporte que atrai pessoas de todos os níveis e idades, promovendo bem-estar e contato social. Geralmente, essas provas oferecem distâncias variadas, como 5 km, 10 km ou até meias maratonas, e muitas vezes percorrem paisagens urbanas ou naturais cênicas, transformando-se numa celebração de esforço. Para uma boa experiência, é crucial planejar a preparação física e a estratégia de prova, além de manter-se hidratado. Curiosamente, muitos desses eventos têm um componente social: parte do valor da inscrição é destinada a organizações de caridade, o que adiciona um valor ainda maior à participação. Além disso, o fato de correr lado a lado com outros torcedores e entusiastas cria um senso de comunidade. A atmosfera festiva, a camaradagem e o orgulho de cruzar a linha de chegada, independentemente da posição ou tempo, tornam essa experiência única e memorável, superando o uso diário de um celular ou o simples fato de pegar um ônibus.
base_en: Running a popular race involves participating in a mass sporting event, open to runners of all levels, ages, and physical conditions. These events offer an excellent opportunity for personal improvement and social interaction, promoting health and well-being. Generally, they include varied distances, such as 5 km, 10 km, or half marathons, and usually cover attractive urban or natural landscapes, becoming a celebration of effort and community. Physical preparation, hydration, and a good race strategy are essential to enjoy the experience and avoid injuries. Many popular races have a charitable component, allocating part of the registration fee to charitable causes and social organizations, which adds extra value to participation and encourages help and commitment. Participants enjoy the festive atmosphere, camaraderie, and the pride of crossing the finish line, whatever their time and position.

text_es: Three years ago, I decided to participate in my first popular race, an experience that mixed nervousness and excitement in equal measure. The training, with its rainy and sunny days, had been tough, but I felt prepared for the challenge. On the morning of the event, the air was cool and filled with the energy and enthusiasm of hundreds of runners. I remember the crowd, the noise, the music, and the encouragement of the people. The first few kilometers were a mix of euphoria and effort, with my legs and my breathing adapting to the pace. Crossing the finish line was a feeling of victory and satisfaction that overcame the fatigue and muscle soreness. Since then, popular races have become a sport and a personal challenge that I greatly appreciate, a fact that has brought me more well-being. It's not something everyone does, but my cell phone helps me record my training and track my results.
text_tgt_raw: Há três anos, decidi participar da minha primeira corrida popular, uma experiência que misturou nervosismo e excitação em igual medida. O treinamento, com seus dias de chuva e sol, tinha sido puxado, mas me sentia preparado para o desafio. Na manhã do evento, o ar estava fresco e repleto da energia e do entusiasmo de centenas de corredores. Lembro-me da multidão, do barulho, da música e do encorajamento das pessoas. Os primeiros quilômetros foram uma mistura de euforia e esforço, com minhas pernas e minha respiração se adaptando ao ritmo. Atravessar a linha de chegada foi uma sensação de vitória e satisfação que superou o cansaço e a dor muscular. Desde então, as corridas populares se tornaram um esporte e um desafio pessoal que aprecio muito, um fato que me trouxe mais bem-estar. Não é algo que qualquer um faça, mas meu celular me ajuda a registrar os treinos e o controle dos resultados.
base_en: 3 years ago, I decided to run my 1st popular race, an experience that combined nerves and excitement in equal measure. The training, with its rainy and sunny days, had been tough, but I felt prepared for the challenge. On the morning of the event, the air was cool and filled with the energy and enthusiasm of hundreds of runners. I remember the crowd, the noise, the music, and the encouragement of the people. The 1st kilometers were a mix of euphoria and effort, with my legs and my breathing acclimating to the rhythm. Crossing the finish line was a feeling of victory and satisfaction that overcame the fatigue and muscle soreness. Since then, popular races have become a passion and a personal challenge that I greatly enjoy.

text_es: For your first popular race, the focus should be on enjoying the experience, more than the time or the ranking. Start with gradual and consistent training, progressively increasing the distance and intensity, always paying attention to your body's signals. Hydration and adequate nutrition, rich in carbohydrates and proteins, are essential facts before and during the event. On race day, arrive early to familiarize yourself with the course and parking, and do a good warm-up and stretching. Maintain a comfortable pace, without trying to go faster than you feel capable, managing your energy. Don't forget a good pair of sneakers and technical clothing, which offer comfort and performance. Afterward, celebrate your achievement and start planning your next challenges.
text_tgt_raw: Para sua primeira corrida popular, o foco deve ser aproveitar a experiência, mais do que o tempo ou a classificação. Comece com um treinamento gradual e consistente, aumentando progressivamente a distância e a intensidade, sempre prestando atenção aos sinais do seu corpo. Hidratação e uma nutrição adequada, ricas em carboidratos e proteínas, são fatos essenciais antes e durante o evento. No dia da corrida, chegue cedo para se familiarizar com o percurso e o estacionamento, e faça um bom aquecimento e alongamento. Mantenha um ritmo confortável, sem tentar ir mais rápido do que se sente capaz, gerenciando sua energia. Não se esqueça de um bom par de tênis e roupas técnicas, que ofereçam conforto e desempenho. Depois, celebre sua conquista e comece a planejar seus próximos desafios.
base_en: For your 1st popular race, focus on enjoying the experience and not so much on time and ranking. Start with gradual and consistent training, progressively increasing distance and intensity, and paying attention to your body and sensations. Hydration and adequate nutrition—with carbohydrates and proteins—are essential before and during the event. On race day, arrive early enough to familiarize yourself with the surroundings and the course, and do a good warm-up and stretches. Maintain a comfortable pace, without trying to go faster than you feel capable, and manage your strength and energy. Don't forget the importance of good footwear and technical clothing, which offer you comfort and performance. Afterward, celebrate your achievement and plan your recovery and future challenges.

text_es: Restoring a piece of antique furniture is an art that requires patience and skill, transforming worn objects into items of beauty and functionality. This process involves several stages, starting with a detailed assessment of the furniture's condition to identify any damage or defects. Generally, this is followed by cleaning, removal of old finishes, and structural repair, which may include gluing joints or replacing damaged wood parts. Next, the piece is sanded and a finish is applied, using varnishes or waxes to protect the surface and enhance the wood's natural beauty, restoring its splendor and value. It is a job that demands dedication and the use of specific tools to ensure an aesthetic and durable result, a fact that contributes to sustainability and the appreciation of our artisanal heritage. For an economical and quality result, the artisan will often plan each step carefully, avoiding unnecessary expenses and ensuring that every inch of the wood is utilized.
text_tgt_raw: Restaurar uma peça de mobiliário antigo é uma arte que exige paciência e habilidade, transformando objetos desgastados em itens de beleza e funcionalidade. Esse processo envolve várias etapas, começando por uma avaliação detalhada da condição do móvel para identificar quaisquer danos ou defeitos. Geralmente, segue-se a limpeza, remoção de acabamentos antigos e reparo da estrutura, o que pode incluir a colagem de juntas ou a substituição de partes de madeira danificadas. Em seguida, lixa-se e aplica-se o acabamento, utilizando vernizes ou ceras para proteger a superfície e realçar a beleza natural da madeira, recuperando seu esplendor e valor. É um trabalho que demanda dedicação e o uso de ferramentas específicas para garantir um resultado estético e duradouro, sendo um fato que contribui para a sustentabilidade e a valorização do nosso patrimônio artesanal. Para um resultado econômico e de qualidade, muitas vezes o artesão planejará cada etapa cuidadosamente, evitando gastos desnecessários e garantindo que cada quilômetro da madeira seja aproveitado.
base_en: Restoring an antique piece of furniture is an art that combines skill and patience, transforming worn pieces into objects of beauty and functionality. This process involves several stages, beginning with a detailed evaluation of the furniture's condition and the identification of damage and defects. Generally, one proceeds with cleaning, stripping, and repairing the structure, which may include gluing joints and replacing wooden parts if necessary. Next, sanding, and finishing are carried out, applying varnishes and waxes to protect the surface and highlight the natural grain and color of the wood, thus recovering its splendor and value. It's a job that requires dedication and the use of specific tools and materials to guarantee a durable and aesthetic result. Furthermore, restoration contributes to sustainability and the appreciation of artisanal and historical heritage.

text_es: Two years ago, I inherited an antique oak desk from my grandmother, a piece full of history and charm. It was quite deteriorated, with cracked wood and peeling varnish, but I saw in it an opportunity and a challenge. I decided to restore it myself, something that required patience and technique, as I wanted to respect its original essence and beauty. I started by carefully sanding the surfaces and applying special products for the wood and hardware, a long but rewarding process. There were moments of frustration and doubt, especially with the more intricate and delicate parts, but the satisfaction of seeing it regain its splendor motivated me. Now, the desk is magnificent in my living room, a blend of history and renewal, and every time I see it, I remember the effort and care I dedicated, and I feel proud and happy to have saved it, a true act of overcoming. For this work, I didn't need to use any bus or train, but my cell phone was crucial for researching techniques and materials. I must say that the result is very economical compared to buying a new one.
text_tgt_raw: Dois anos atrás, herdei uma escrivaninha antiga de carvalho da minha avó, uma peça cheia de história e charme. Ela estava bem deteriorada, com a madeira rachada e o verniz descascando, mas vi nela uma oportunidade e um desafio. Decidi restaurá-la eu mesmo, algo que exigiu paciência e técnica, pois queria respeitar sua essência e beleza originais. Comecei lixando cuidadosamente as superfícies e aplicando produtos especiais para a madeira e as ferragens, um processo longo, mas recompensador. Houve momentos de frustração e dúvida, especialmente com as partes mais intrincadas e delicadas, mas a satisfação de vê-la recuperar seu esplendor me motivou. Agora, a escrivaninha está magnífica na minha sala, uma mistura de história e renovação, e toda vez que a vejo, lembro-me do esforço e carinho que dediquei, e me sinto orgulhoso e feliz por tê-la salvado, um verdadeiro fato de superação. Para esse trabalho, não precisei usar nenhum ônibus ou trem, mas meu celular foi crucial para pesquisar técnicas e materiais. Devo dizer que o resultado é bem econômico comparado a comprar uma nova.
base_en: 2 years ago, I inherited an old oak desk from my grandmother, a piece with a lot of history and charm. It was quite deteriorated, with cracked wood and peeling varnish, but I saw in it an opportunity and a challenge. I decided to restore it myself, something that required patience and technique, because I wanted to respect its original essence and beauty. I started by carefully sanding the surfaces and applying special products for the wood and hardware, a long but rewarding process. There were moments of frustration and doubt, especially with the most intricate and delicate parts, but the satisfaction of seeing it regain its splendor motivated me. Now the desk looks magnificent in my living room, a mix of history and renovation, and every time I look at it, I remember the effort and affection I put into it, and I feel proud and happy to have saved it.

text_es: To restore an antique piece of furniture, an essential fact is to start with good preparation and cleaning. Assess the condition of the piece – wood and hardware – to determine the necessary steps, such as repairing structural damage or replacing parts. Gently sand the surface to remove old varnish or paint, using medium and fine-grit sandpaper to achieve a smooth and uniform texture. Apply an appropriate primer to ensure the adhesion and durability of the new finish, protecting the wood and extending its lifespan, which is quite economical in the long run. Afterward, choose the desired paint or varnish, applying several thin coats for a professional and long-lasting result. Finally, protect the furniture with a sealer or wax to maintain its beauty and resistance to moisture and wear. You will enjoy the process and the result of your patience and effort, perhaps even while drinking pineapple juice.
text_tgt_raw: Para restaurar uma peça de mobiliário antiga, um fato essencial é começar com uma boa preparação e limpeza. Avalie a condição da peça – madeira e ferragens – para determinar os passos necessários, como reparar danos estruturais ou substituir partes. Lixe suavemente a superfície para remover verniz ou tinta antiga, usando lixas de grão médio e fino para obter uma textura lisa e uniforme. Aplique um primer adequado para garantir a adesão e durabilidade do novo acabamento, protegendo a madeira e prolongando sua vida útil, o que é bem econômico a longo prazo. Depois, escolha a tinta ou verniz desejado, aplicando várias camadas finas para um resultado profissional e duradouro. Para finalizar, proteja o móvel com um selador ou cera para manter sua beleza e resistência à umidade e ao desgaste. Você vai desfrutar do processo e do resultado da sua paciência e esforço, talvez até tomando um suco de abacaxi.
base_en: To restore an antique piece of furniture, it's essential to start with good preparation and cleaning. Evaluate the condition of the piece—wood and hardware—to determine the necessary steps, such as repairing structural damage and replacing parts. Gently sand the surface to remove old varnish or paint, using medium and fine-grit sandpaper to achieve a smooth and uniform texture. Apply an appropriate primer to ensure the adhesion and durability of the new finish, protecting the wood and giving it a longer useful life. Then, choose the paint or varnish you want, applying several thin coats for a professional and durable result. Finally, protect the furniture with a sealer or wax to maintain its beauty and resistance to moisture and wear. You'll enjoy the process and the result of your patience and effort.

text_es: Planning a birthday party requires attention to detail and good planning, and it can be a very rewarding and fun experience. First, it's crucial to define the date, time, budget, and guest list, considering the venue and style of the celebration. Next, choosing a theme and decorations are essential, ensuring there's enough food and drink for everyone, which usually involves preparing or ordering snacks and main dishes. Thinking about music and entertainment, such as games or recreational sports, is also important to keep participants happy and lively. Don't forget the cake and candles, which are expected and fundamental elements. Finally, it's essential to send out invitations and confirm guests' attendance to have a clear idea of the number of people, allowing you to manage space and resources economically and efficiently.
text_tgt_raw: Planejar uma festa de aniversário exige atenção aos detalhes e um bom planejamento, podendo ser uma experiência bastante gratificante e divertida. Primeiramente, é crucial definir a data, hora, orçamento e a lista de convidados, considerando o local e o estilo da celebração. Em seguida, a escolha de um tema e da decoração são essenciais, garantindo que haja comida e bebida suficientes para todos, o que geralmente envolve preparar ou pedir petiscos e pratos principais. Pensar na música e no entretenimento, como jogos ou esportes recreativos, também é importante para manter os participantes alegres e animados. Não se esqueça do bolo e das velas, que são elementos esperados e fundamentais. Por fim, é fundamental enviar os convites e confirmar a presença dos convidados para ter uma ideia clara do número de pessoas, permitindo gerenciar o espaço e os recursos de forma econômica e eficiente.
base_en: Organizing a birthday party requires planning and attention to detail and can be a rewarding and fun experience. 1st, it's essential to decide the date and time, as well as the budget and guests, thinking about the venue and style of celebration. Then, a theme and decoration must be chosen, making sure there's enough food and drink for everyone, which often involves preparing or ordering appetizers and main courses. It's also important to think about music and entertainment, such as games or activities, to keep attendees happy and lively. Don't forget the cake and candles, which are essential and expected elements. Finally, it's key to send out invitations and confirm attendance, to have a clear idea of the number of people and successfully organize the space and resources.

text_es: This year, organizing my birthday party was quite an adventure, a true personal challenge. I started with the guest list, thinking about the friends and family I truly wanted close by to share laughs and good times. Next, I needed to decide on the venue and date—something that always causes me a certain amount of stress—and, after a few calls and cell phone messages, I managed to reserve a cozy little hall for a Saturday, March 15th. The decoration was a key point; I bought balloons, streamers, and even made some garlands by hand, aiming for a festive and welcoming atmosphere. The food and drinks were the most fun part to plan; I thought of a simple buffet with sandwiches and various appetizers, plus a cake and juices for all tastes and ages. Fortunately, my sister and brother-in-law helped me a lot with the preparations, easing the workload and stress. In the end, the party was a phenomenon, with music and dancing that lasted until night, and everyone enjoyed the company and the celebration. It was a fact that their help made everything more convenient and less academic, transforming the planning into a fun sport.
text_tgt_raw: Este ano, organizar minha festa de aniversário foi uma aventura e tanto, um verdadeiro desafio pessoal. Comecei com a lista de convidados, pensando nos amigos e na família que eu realmente queria por perto para compartilhar risadas e bons momentos. Em seguida, precisei decidir o local e a data – algo que sempre me causa um certo estresse –, e, depois de algumas ligações e mensagens pelo celular, consegui reservar um salãozinho bem aconchegante para um sábado, 15 de março. The decoration was a key point; I bought balloons and streamers, and I even made some garlands by hand, looking for a festive and warm atmosphere. The food and drinks were the most fun part to plan; I thought of a simple buffet with sandwiches and various appetizers, plus a cake and soft drinks for all tastes and ages. text_es: To organize a successful birthday party, planning and anticipation are crucial. Start by defining the date and time, as well as the budget and guest list. Think about the theme and decoration—balloons and streamers, for example—elements that will create a festive and memorable atmosphere. Don't forget the food and drinks: opt for options that most people like and that are easy to serve, such as snacks and various juices. Music and games are also important to keep everyone's spirits high and entertained, from the youngest to the adults. Confirm guests' attendance 1 or 2 weeks in advance to get an approximate number, and make any necessary last-minute purchases with time and peace of mind. With these tips and a positive attitude, your celebration will be a fact and a joy for the birthday person and their loved ones. Considering transportation like a bus or ample parking for guests can also be helpful. And for those who enjoy a good breakfast the next day, plan something delicious!
text_tgt_raw: Para organizar uma festa de aniversário de sucesso, planejamento e antecipação são cruciais. Comece definindo a data e o horário, assim como o orçamento e a lista de convidados. Pense no tema e na decoração — balões e serpentinas, por exemplo — elementos que criarão uma atmosfera festiva e memorável. Não se esqueça da comida e das bebidas: opte por opções que a maioria das pessoas goste e que sejam fáceis de servir, como salgadinhos e sucos variados. Música e jogos também são importantes para manter o astral de todos elevado e entretido, dos mais jovens aos adultos. Confirme a presença dos convidados com 1 ou 2 semanas de antecedência para ter um número aproximado, e faça quaisquer compras de última hora necessárias com tempo e tranquilidade. Com essas dicas e uma atitude positiva, sua celebração será um fato e uma alegria para o aniversariante e seus entes queridos. Considerar um transporte como ônibus ou um estacionamento amplo para os convidados também pode ser útil. E para quem gosta de um bom café da manhã no dia seguinte, planeje algo gostoso!
base_en: To organize a successful birthday party, planning, and anticipation are key. Start by defining the date and time, as well as the budget and guest list. Think about the theme and decoration—balloons and streamers, for example—elements that will create a festive and memorable atmosphere. Don't forget the food and drinks: opt for options that most people will like and that are easy to serve, such as appetizers and various soft drinks. Music and games are also important to keep everyone's spirits up and entertained, from the youngest to the adults. Confirm guests' attendance 1 or 2 weeks in advance to get an approximate number, and make any necessary last-minute purchases with time and peace of mind. With these tips and a good attitude, your celebration will be a success and a joy for the birthday person and their loved ones.

text_es: Caring for indoor plants requires specific attention and knowledge to ensure their growth and well-being. It is a fact that we must consider the appropriate light and temperature for each species, as insufficient or excessive exposure can be harmful. Watering is another crucial factor; it is important to find a balance between moisture and drainage, avoiding both waterlogging and extreme drying out of the soil. Quality substrate and occasional fertilization are essential to provide the necessary nutrients and minerals for their development. Furthermore, pruning and regular cleaning of the leaves help prevent pests and diseases, maintaining the plant's health and vitality. Planning these cares and meeting the specific needs of each plant and pot will ensure a green home full of life, without the need to spend money on parking to pick up new flowers or on a truck for transport.
text_tgt_raw: Cuidar de plantas de interior exige atenção específica e conhecimento para garantir seu crescimento e bem-estar. É fato que devemos considerar a luz e a temperatura apropriadas para cada espécie, pois a exposição insuficiente ou excessiva pode ser prejudicial. A rega é outro fator crucial; é importante encontrar um equilíbrio entre umidade e drenagem, evitando tanto o encharcamento quanto o ressecamento extremo do solo. Um substrato de qualidade e a fertilização ocasional são essenciais para fornecer os nutrientes e minerais necessários para seu desenvolvimento. Além disso, a poda e a limpeza regular das folhas ajudam a prevenir pragas e doenças, mantendo a saúde e a vitalidade da planta. Planejar esses cuidados e atender às necessidades específicas de cada planta e vaso garantirá um lar verde e cheio de vida, sem a necessidade de gastar com estacionamento para buscar flores novas ou com um caminhão para transporte.
base_en: Caring for indoor plants requires specific attention and knowledge to ensure their growth and well-being. It's essential to consider the appropriate light and temperature for each species, as insufficient or excessive exposure can be detrimental. Watering is another crucial factor; it's important to find a balance between humidity and drainage, avoiding both waterlogging and extreme dryness of the soil. A quality substrate and occasional fertilization are essential to provide the necessary nutrients and minerals for their development. In addition, pruning, and regular cleaning of the leaves help prevent pests and diseases, maintaining the plant's health and vitality. Paying attention to these details and to the specific needs of each plant and pot will guarantee a green and lively home.

text_es: I confess that, at first, taking care of houseplants was a source of stress and frustration for me. I bought pots and seeds with great enthusiasm, but most of my acquisitions ended up wilting in a matter of weeks or even days. I learned, for example, that light and water are essential, but the quantity and frequency can vary greatly among species and varieties, a fact that surprised me. My ficus and calatheas, in particular, taught me a lot about patience and observation. Today, I enjoy the calm and beauty they bring to my home and, honestly, it's an activity that relaxes the mind and body. It's not just a hobby; it's a deep connection with nature and life, something an academic would certainly appreciate, and it even makes me forget about the traffic on the bus. And to think that before I thought it was a difficult phenomenon to master, but now I can even plan a juice rotation for my plants.
text_tgt_raw: Confesso que, no início, cuidar de plantas de casa era uma fonte de estresse e frustração para mim. Comprei vasos e sementes com grande entusiasmo, mas a maioria das minhas aquisições acabava murchando em questão de semanas ou até dias. Aprendi, por exemplo, que luz e água são essenciais, mas a quantidade e a frequência podem variar muito entre as espécies e variedades, um fato que me surpreendeu. Meus ficus e calatheas, em particular, me ensinaram bastante sobre paciência e observação. Hoje, desfruto da calma e da beleza que trazem para meu lar e, honestamente, é uma atividade que relaxa a mente e o corpo. Não é apenas um hobby; é um contato profundo com a natureza e a vida, algo que um acadêmico certamente apreciaria, e que me faz até esquecer do trânsito no ônibus. E pensar que antes eu achava que era um fenômeno difícil de dominar, mas agora até consigo planejar um rodízio de suco para minhas plantas.
base_en: I recognize that caring for houseplants was, at 1st, a source of stress and frustration for me. I bought pots and seeds with great excitement, only to see most of my acquisitions end up wilting in a matter of weeks and days. I learned, for example, that light and water are essential, but the amount and frequency can vary greatly among species and varieties. My ficuses and calatheas, in particular, have taught me a lot of patience and observation. Now I enjoy the calm and beauty they bring to my home and, honestly, it's an activity that relaxes my mind and body. It's not just a hobby; it's a connection with nature and life.

text_es: To properly care for indoor plants, good planning is essential. Before buying, it is economical to research the specific needs of each plant, such as light and humidity. Ensure adequate pots and substrate, as good drainage and soil nutrition are key for development. Watering is essential; avoid excess or lack, always checking the soil and the weight of the pot. Observe the leaves and stems; they will provide facts about health and possible problems or pests. Correct light and temperature, with optimal ventilation and humidity, are vital for their well-being. Don't forget regular pruning and cleaning of the leaves, which will promote vigorous growth, transforming your home environment into a more pleasant and scenic space.
text_tgt_raw: Para cuidar bem de plantas de interior, um bom planejamento é fundamental. Antes de comprar, é econômico pesquisar as necessidades específicas de cada planta, como luz e umidade. Garanta vasos e substrato adequados, pois uma boa drenagem e nutrição do solo são chaves para o desenvolvimento. A rega é essencial; evite excessos ou falta, sempre checando o solo e o peso do vaso. Observe as folhas e caules, eles darão fatos sobre a saúde e possíveis problemas ou pragas. Luz e temperatura corretas, com ventilação e umidade ótimas, são vitais para o bem-estar delas. Não se esqueça da poda regular e da limpeza das folhas, o que promoverá um crescimento vigoroso, transformando o ambiente da sua casa num espaço mais agradável e cênico.
base_en: To successfully care for indoor plants, a good start and planning are essential. Research the specific needs of each plant, such as light and humidity, before buying it. Make sure you've adequate pots and substrate, as good drainage and soil nutrition are key for their development. Watering is fundamental, but avoid overwatering and underwatering, always checking the soil and the weight of the pot. Pay attention to the leaves and stems, as they'll give you clues about their health and possible problems or pests. The correct light and temperature, along with optimal ventilation and humidity, are vital for their well-being. Don't forget regular pruning and cleaning of leaves, which will promote healthy and vigorous growth, and provide a pleasant environment and atmosphere in your home.

text_es: Choosing the right mattress is fundamental for our health and well-being, a fact that is often underestimated. We should consider several factors and personal preferences, such as firmness and support. A mattress that is too soft or too hard can cause pain and discomfort, harming sleep and even daily activities, like taking the bus to work. There are various types of materials, such as memory foam, latex, and springs, each with its advantages and disadvantages in terms of adaptability and breathability. It is crucial to test the mattress for at least 10 to 15 minutes to assess its comfort and how the body responds. Furthermore, sleeping position and body weight directly influence pressure distribution and spinal and neck alignment. A good mattress is a long-term economic investment that improves sleep quality and overall muscle and physical recovery. Don't forget to check the durability and warranty, which are indicators of the manufacturer's quality and their commitment to the product and the customer.
text_tgt_raw: Escolher o colchão certo é fundamental para nossa saúde e bem-estar, um fato que muitas vezes é subestimado. Devemos considerar diversos fatores e preferências pessoais, como a firmeza e o suporte. Um colchão muito macio ou muito duro pode causar dores e desconforto, prejudicando o sono e até mesmo as atividades diárias, como ir ao trabalho de ônibus. Existem diversos tipos de materiais, como espuma viscoelástica, látex e molas, cada um com suas vantagens e desvantagens em termos de adaptabilidade e respirabilidade. É crucial testar o colchão por pelo menos 10 a 15 minutos para avaliar seu conforto e como o corpo responde. Além disso, a posição de dormir e o peso corporal influenciam diretamente na distribuição da pressão e no alinhamento da coluna e do pescoço. Um bom colchão é um investimento econômico a longo prazo, que melhora a qualidade do sono e a recuperação muscular e física geral. Não se esqueça de verificar a durabilidade e a garantia, que são indicadores da qualidade do fabricante e de seu compromisso com o produto e com o cliente.
base_en: Choosing the right mattress is fundamental for health and well-being, so it's important to consider various factors and personal preferences. Firmness and support are key aspects; a mattress that's too soft or too hard can cause aches and discomfort. There are diverse types of materials, such as memory foam, latex, and springs, each with its own advantages and disadvantages in terms of adaptability and breathability. It's crucial to try out the mattress for at least 10 to 15 minutes to evaluate its comfort and body response. Also consider your sleeping posture and your weight, as they directly influence pressure distribution and the alignment of your spine and neck. A good mattress can improve sleep quality and overall muscular and physical recovery. Don't forget durability and warranty, which are indicators of the manufacturer's quality and commitment to the product and the customer.

text_es: Choosing a mattress is a true odyssey! I remember about 3 years ago, when my old mattress no longer offered comfort or support. My mornings started with back and neck pain, and my partner and I decided it was time to invest in good rest. We visited several stores, trying spring and memory foam models, and the truth is that the variety of options and prices was overwhelming. The salespeople explained the differences between firmness and adaptability, and told us about materials and technologies with great enthusiasm, almost like a market phenomenon. We spent hours lying on different models, trying to discern the subtle variations between a firm and a medium mattress, and in the end, after much deliberation and discussing the facts, we opted for a medium-firmness one with a memory foam layer, which promised good rest and durability. The choice was a relief, and now I enjoy restorative sleep and peaceful nights, which I consider a very economical investment in my health. If I had to take a bus or a train to find the perfect mattress, I would have gone without thinking twice, but fortunately, we were able to research everything on our phones while having a delicious breakfast.
text_tgt_raw: Escolher um colchão é uma verdadeira odisseia! Lembro-me de uns 3 anos atrás, quando meu colchão antigo já não oferecia conforto nem apoio. Minhas manhãs começavam com dores nas costas e no pescoço, e meu parceiro e eu decidimos que era hora de investir em um bom descanso. Visitamos diversas lojas, experimentando modelos de molas e espuma viscoelástica, e a verdade é que a variedade de opções e preços era avassaladora. Os vendedores nos explicaram as diferenças entre firmeza e adaptabilidade, e nos falaram sobre materiais e tecnologias com grande entusiasmo, quase como um fenômeno do mercado. Passamos horas deitados em diferentes modelos, tentando discernir as sutis variações entre um colchão firme e um médio, e no final, após muita deliberação e discutir os fatos, optamos por um de firmeza média com uma camada de espuma viscoelástica, que prometia bom descanso e durabilidade. A escolha foi um alívio, e agora desfruto de um sono reparador e noites tranquilas, o que considero um investimento muito econômico na minha saúde. text_es: When choosing a mattress, the fact is that prioritizing your rest and health is fundamental, after all, sleeping well directly impacts your energy and overall well-being. Think about the type of material – springs, memory foam, latex, and foam – seeking the ideal balance between firmness and adaptability that your body needs. It is vital to try the mattress in person; lie down and feel the comfort and support it offers, paying attention to your spine and neck posture, as if you were relaxing after a long day of work or watching a soccer game. Don't be guided only by price; durability and quality are a long-term economic investment. Also consider your sleeping position and whether you share the bed with someone else, ensuring space and comfort for both. Check the warranty and return policies, as they are an important record and a bonus for your peace of mind.

Não se guie apenas pelo preço; a durabilidade e a qualidade são um investimento econômico a longo prazo. Considere também sua posição ao dormir e se você compartilha a cama com outra pessoa, garantindo espaço e conforto para ambos. Verifique as políticas de garantia e devolução, pois elas são um registro importante e um bônus para sua tranquilidade.
base_en: When choosing a mattress, the key is to prioritize your rest and health, since sleeping well impacts your energy and general well-being. Consider the type of material—springs and memory foam, latex, and foam—looking for the balance between firmness and adaptability that your body needs. It's vital to try it in person; lie down and feel the comfort and support it offers, paying attention to the posture of your back and neck. Don't be guided only by price and offers; durability and quality are long-term investments. Also think about your sleeping posture—on your back and side, on your stomach—and if you share the bed with another person so that both of you've space and comfort. Find out about the warranty and return policies, as they're insurance for your purchase and your peace of mind.

text_es: Reducing food waste is a fundamental fact for the environment and society. This involves better planning and food purchasing, avoiding unnecessary excesses. It is crucial to store products properly, considering their freshness, to preserve their properties and flavor. Furthermore, using leftovers and giving a second life to ingredients, such as peels and stalks, reduces the amount of trash. This practice not only saves resources but also contributes to food security and reduces the carbon footprint, making it an economical attitude. For example, we can make juices with fruits that are almost spoiling or use pineapple peels to make a delicious tea. Adopting conscious consumption habits is key to combating this global problem and promoting sustainability, benefiting the entire team of our planet.
text_tgt_raw: Reduzir o desperdício de alimentos é um fato fundamental para o meio ambiente e a sociedade. Isso envolve um melhor planejamento e compra de alimentos, evitando excessos desnecessários. É crucial armazenar os produtos adequadamente, considerando sua frescura, para preservar suas propriedades e sabor. Além disso, usar sobras e dar uma segunda vida a ingredientes, como cascas e talos, diminui a quantidade de lixo. Essa prática não só gera economia de recursos, como também contribui para a segurança alimentar e reduz a pegada de carbono, tornando-se uma atitude econômica. Por exemplo, podemos fazer sucos com frutas que estão quase estragando ou usar cascas de abacaxi para fazer um chá delicioso. Adotar hábitos de consumo conscientes é a chave para combater esse problema global e promover a sustentabilidade, beneficiando a equipe inteira do nosso planeta.
base_en: Reducing food waste is a fundamental action for the environment and society. It involves better food planning and purchasing, avoiding unnecessary excesses and waste. It's crucial to store products properly, considering their freshness and duration, to preserve their properties and flavor. Furthermore, using leftovers and giving ingredients and parts of food—such as peels and stems—a 2nd life, decreases the amount of waste. This practice not only generates economic savings and saves water and energy resources, but it also contributes to food security and reduces the carbon footprint and pollution. Adopting responsible and conscious consumption habits is key to combating this global problem and promoting sustainability and the well-being of everyone.

text_es: Last week, while organizing the refrigerator and pantry, I realized the enormous amount of food that sometimes goes to waste, and I felt a mix of guilt and frustration. I have always tried to be conscious in my shopping and consumption, but modern life and daily rushes often lead me to buy too much or forget food at the back of the drawer. I decided it was time to take more serious steps to reduce waste, so I researched tips and tricks. I started planning my menus and quantities better, which resulted in surprising time and money savings. Furthermore, I now try to reuse leftovers—like stale bread and wilted vegetables—to make broths and soups, giving them a second chance. I believe that small changes in our habits and attitudes can generate a significant economic impact on the environment and our wallets. It's a constant challenge, but the satisfaction and benefit are great, a fact that motivates me to continue.
text_tgt_raw: Na semana passada, enquanto organizava a geladeira e a despensa, percebi a enorme quantidade de comida que, às vezes, vai para o lixo, e senti um misto de culpa e frustração. Sempre procurei ser consciente em minhas compras e consumo, mas a vida moderna e as correrias diárias frequentemente me levam a comprar demais ou esquecer alimentos no fundo da gaveta. Decidi que era hora de tomar medidas mais sérias para reduzir o desperdício, então pesquisei dicas e truques. Comecei a planejar melhor meus cardápios e quantidades, o que resultou em uma economia de tempo e dinheiro surpreendente. Além disso, agora tento reaproveitar sobras – como pão amanhecido e vegetais murchos – para fazer caldos e sopas, dando-lhes uma segunda chance. Acredito que pequenas mudanças em nossos hábitos e atitudes podem gerar um impacto econômico significativo no meio ambiente e em nossos bolsos. É um desafio constante, mas a satisfação e o benefício são grandes, um fato que me motiva a continuar.
