The benefits are numerous: it improves cognitive functions like memory and problem-solving, facilitates communication when traveling—whether to catch a bus or a train—and expands professional opportunities in an increasingly globalized world. There are various methodologies for this, from formal classes to self-taught learning, and total or partial immersion is usually the most economical and effective. The key to success lies in personal and intrinsic motivation, as well as maintaining a positive attitude towards mistakes, considering them learning opportunities and not an impediment. With 15% of the world's population speaking more than one language, it is an invaluable and super useful skill for managing the complexity of the modern world, perhaps even for ordering a juice in another country.
text_tgt_raw: Aprender um novo idioma é uma experiência enriquecedora e desafiadora que nos abre portas para novas culturas e perspectivas, um fato que muitos já reconhecem. Envolve a aquisição de vocabulário, gramática e fonética, exigindo dedicação constante e prática regular, como um atleta em busca da perfeição em seu esporte. Os benefícios são inúmeros: melhora funções cognitivas como memória e resolução de problemas, facilita a comunicação em viagens – seja para pegar um ônibus ou um trem – e expande oportunidades profissionais em um mundo cada vez mais globalizado. Existem diversas metodologias para isso, desde aulas formais até o aprendizado autodidata, e a imersão total ou parcial costuma ser a mais econômica e eficaz. A chave para o sucesso reside na motivação pessoal e intrínseca, além de manter uma atitude positiva em relação aos erros, considerando-os oportunidades de aprendizado e não um impedimento. Com 15% da população mundial falando mais de um idioma, é uma habilidade de valor inestimável e super útil para gerenciar a complexidade do mundo moderno, talvez até mesmo para pedir um suco em outro país.
base_en: Learning a new language is an enriching and challenging experience that opens doors to new cultures and perspectives. It involves the acquisition of vocabulary, grammar, and phonetics, which requires constant and patient dedication and regular practice. The benefits are numerous: it improves cognitive functions—such as memory and problem-solving—facilitates communication while traveling, and expands professional opportunities in an increasingly globalized world. There are diverse methodologies—from formal classes to self-learning—to achieve this, and total or partial immersion in the language is often the most effective. The key to success lies in personal and intrinsic motivation and in maintaining a positive attitude toward mistakes—an inherent part of the process—considering them learning opportunities. With 15% of the world's population speaking more than 1 language, it's a valuable skill.

text_es: I vividly remember the first time I tried to learn Japanese, five years ago. It was a challenge and still is, mainly because the writing system is totally different from ours. In the beginning, memorizing hiragana and katakana was torture—I thought I'd never get it—with their 46 basic characters each. Every day I dedicated an hour, or even more, to reviewing, using flashcards and watching anime without subtitles, an economical and effective strategy. The frustration was real, but the satisfaction of understanding a sentence, even a simple one, pushed me to continue. Now, after so much effort, and still in progress, I can have basic conversations and read manga. It's a fact that it has been an enriching experience that I recommend to everyone, a true exercise for the brain that compares to some sports. If one day you're on a trip and need to communicate, having a cell phone with access to a translator also helps.
text_tgt_raw: Lembro-me vividamente da primeira vez que tentei aprender japonês, há cinco anos. Foi um desafio e ainda é, principalmente porque o sistema de escrita é totalmente diferente do nosso. No começo, memorizar hiragana e katakana era uma tortura – pensei que nunca conseguiria –, com seus 46 caracteres básicos cada. Todos os dias eu dedicava uma hora, ou até mais, para revisar, usando flashcards e assistindo a animes sem legendas, uma estratégia econômica e eficaz. A frustração era real, mas a satisfação de entender uma frase, mesmo que simples, me impulsionava a continuar. Agora, depois de tanto esforço, e ainda em processo, consigo ter conversas básicas e ler mangás. É um fato que tem sido uma experiência enriquecedora e que recomendo a todos, um verdadeiro exercício para o cérebro que se compara a alguns esportes. Se um dia você estiver em uma viagem e precisar se comunicar, ter um celular com acesso a um tradutor também ajuda.
base_en: I vividly remember the 1st time I tried to learn Japanese—5 years ago now. It was a challenge—it still is—because the writing system is completely different from ours. At 1st, memorizing hiragana and katakana was torture—I thought I'd never succeed—with their 46 basic characters each. Every day I dedicated 1 hour—or even more—to reviewing, using flashcards and watching anime without subtitles—a good strategy. The frustration was real, but the satisfaction of understanding a sentence—even if it was simple—drove me to continue. Now, after so much effort—and still in process—I can hold basic conversations and read manga. It has been an enriching experience—and one I recommend to everyone.

text_es: Learning a new language is a rewarding challenge, and immersion is key. Start by engaging with the language: listen to music or podcasts, even while riding the bus or commuting, and watch series or movies in their original version—with subtitles at first—to get your ear accustomed to the sounds and intonation. Practice daily, even if it's just for 10 or 15 minutes, trying to speak from day one, without fear of making mistakes; errors are important facts of the learning process. If your budget allows, find an exchange partner or a teacher who can correct and motivate you. Don't obsess over grammar at first; fluency comes first. Focus on communicating and understanding the essentials, expanding your vocabulary with useful words and phrases for your daily life, like ordering an ice cream or a juice. Prioritize what you will use, such as managing your study files or planning your breakfast. Consistency and patience are your best allies on this academic and personal journey.
text_tgt_raw: Aprender um novo idioma é um desafio gratificante, e a imersão é fundamental. Comece se envolvendo com a língua: ouça música ou podcasts, mesmo enquanto viaja de ônibus ou se desloca, e assista a séries ou filmes na versão original — com legendas no início — para acostumar seu ouvido aos sons e à entonação. Pratique diariamente, nem que seja por 10 ou 15 minutos, tentando falar desde o primeiro dia, sem medo de errar; erros são fatos importantes do processo de aprendizado. Se o seu orçamento permitir, encontre um parceiro de intercâmbio ou um professor que possa te corrigir e motivar. Não se obsseda com a gramática no início; a fluência vem primeiro. Foque em se comunicar e entender o essencial, expandindo seu vocabulário com palavras e frases úteis para o seu dia a dia, como pedir um sorvete ou um suco. Priorize o que você vai usar, como gerenciar seus arquivos de estudo ou planejar o seu café da manhã. Consistência e paciência são seus melhores aliados nesta jornada acadêmica e pessoal.
base_en: To learn a new language—a rewarding challenge—immersion is key. Start by surrounding yourself with the language, listening to music or podcasts—even while doing other things—and watching series or movies in their original version—with subtitles at 1st—to get your ear accustomed to the sounds and intonation. Practice daily—even if it's 10 or 15 minutes—trying to speak from day 1, without fear of making mistakes—they're part of the learning process. Find an exchange partner or a teacher—if your budget allows—who can correct and motivate you. Don't obsess over grammar at 1st—fluency comes 1st—; focus on communicating and understanding the essentials, expanding your vocabulary with useful words and phrases for your daily life—prioritize what you'll use. Consistency and patience are your best allies on this exciting journey.

text_es: Participating in a popular race, whether a marathon or half marathon, is a sport that involves a massive event, open to runners of all levels. These races, often urban, have predefined distances such as 5 km, 10 km, 21 kilometers (half marathon), or 42 kilometers (marathon), and their biggest appeal, besides the competition, is the collective experience and festive atmosphere. Runners, from experienced athletes to beginners, prepare months in advance, following specific training plans to improve endurance and prevent injuries. Registration usually includes a bib number with an electronic chip for timing, a commemorative t-shirt, and access to hydration stations along the course. Finishing a popular race, especially the first one, is an accomplishment that represents a significant personal achievement, often encouraging a more active and economical lifestyle. Many runners, motivated by solidarity, use these events to raise funds for charitable causes, some even using public transportation, like the bus, to get to the location.
text_tgt_raw: Participar de uma corrida popular, seja uma maratona ou meia maratona, é um esporte que envolve um evento massivo, aberto a corredores de todos os níveis. Essas provas, frequentemente urbanas, possuem distâncias pré-definidas como 5 km, 10 km, 21 quilômetros (meia maratona) ou 42 quilômetros (maratona), e seu maior atrativo, além da competição, é a experiência coletiva e a atmosfera festiva. Corredores, desde atletas experientes até iniciantes, preparam-se com meses de antecedência, seguindo planos de treinamento específicos para melhorar a resistência e evitar lesões. A inscrição geralmente inclui um número de peito com chip eletrônico para cronometragem, uma camiseta comemorativa e acesso a pontos de hidratação ao longo do percurso. Concluir uma corrida popular, principalmente a primeira, é um fato que representa uma conquista pessoal significativa, muitas vezes incentivando um estilo de vida mais ativo e econômico. Muitos corredores, motivados pela solidariedade, utilizam esses eventos para arrecadar fundos para causas beneficentes, alguns até usando o transporte público, como o ônibus, para chegar ao local.
base_en: Running a popular race—also known as a marathon or half marathon—involves participating in a mass sporting event, open to runners of all skill levels. These events—often urban—have predefined distances, such as 5 km, 10 km, 21 km (half marathon), or 42 km (marathon), and their main appeal—beyond the competition—is the collective experience and festive atmosphere. Participants—from experienced athletes to beginners—prepare months in advance, following specific training plans to improve their endurance and avoid injuries. Registration usually includes a bib number—with a timing chip—a commemorative t-shirt, and access to aid stations along the route. Finishing a popular race—especially the 1st one—is a significant personal achievement that often promotes a more active and healthy lifestyle. Many runners—motivated by solidarity—use these events to raise funds for charitable causes.

text_es: The first time I decided to run a popular race — an experience I always wanted to have — was an unexpected challenge. I signed up three weeks before, without much planning, just a little daily running, and the fact is I underestimated the difficulty. On race day, a sunny spring Sunday, the atmosphere was electric, with supporters everywhere. In the beginning, everything went well, I felt the group's energy, but around kilometer 5 my legs started to give out, my calves burned. I remember thinking about giving up, I was exhausted, but seeing the other runners and the public's support gave me the strength to continue. Finally, I crossed the finish line, a personal achievement, exhausted, but with an immense satisfaction that still stays with me today.
text_tgt_raw: A primeira vez que decidi correr uma corrida popular — uma experiência que sempre quis ter — foi um desafio inesperado. Me inscrevi três semanas antes, sem muito planejamento, apenas um pouco de corrida diária, e o fato é que subestimei a dificuldade. No dia da prova, um domingo ensolarado de primavera, a atmosfera estava eletrizante, com torcedores por toda parte. No começo, tudo correu bem, senti a energia do grupo, mas por volta do quilômetro 5 minhas pernas começaram a falhar, minhas panturrilhas ardiam. Lembro-me de pensar em desistir, estava exausto, mas ver os outros corredores e o apoio do público me deu força para continuar. Finalmente, cruzei a linha de chegada, uma conquista pessoal, exausto, mas com uma satisfação imensa que ainda me acompanha hoje.
base_en: The 1st time I decided to run a popular race—an experience I always wanted to have—it was an unexpected challenge. I signed up 3 weeks before, without much preparation—just a little daily jogging—and the truth is I underestimated the difficulty. On race day—a sunny spring Sunday—the atmosphere was electrifying, with people cheering everywhere. At 1st everything went well—I felt the group's energy—but around km 5 my legs started to give out—my calves were burning. I remember thinking about quitting—I was exhausted—but seeing the other runners and the public's support gave me strength to continue. Finally, I crossed the finish line—a personal achievement—exhausted, but with immense satisfaction that still stays with me today.

text_es: If you're starting in the world of popular races – a super rewarding experience – it's essential to plan well and prepare adequately to make the most of every mile. Start with gradual training, without rushing, increasing the distance and intensity of your sessions to avoid injuries, a common occurrence if you're not careful. It's crucial to take care of your diet, the essential fuel for your body, and ensure good hydration, drinking juice and water before, during, and after. Choose appropriate shoes – the investment is worth it – and comfortable clothes that allow free movement. During the race, maintain an economical and consistent pace, without starting too fast, and listen to your body, without overdoing it. Enjoy the atmosphere, the energy of the fans, and every moment. The finish line is just the beginning of many other challenges in the sport!
text_tgt_raw: Se você está começando no mundo das corridas populares – uma experiência super recompensadora – é essencial planejar bem e se preparar adequadamente para aproveitar ao máximo cada quilômetro. Comece com um treinamento gradual, sem pressa, aumentando a distância e a intensidade de suas sessões para evitar lesões, um fato comum se não tiver cuidado. É crucial cuidar da sua dieta, o combustível essencial para o corpo, e garantir uma boa hidratação, tomando suco e água antes, durante e depois. Escolha tênis apropriados – o investimento vale a pena – e roupas confortáveis que permitam movimento livre. Durante a prova, mantenha um ritmo econômico e consistente, sem começar rápido demais, e ouça seu corpo, sem se exceder. Aproveite a atmosfera, a energia dos torcedores e cada momento. A linha de chegada é apenas o começo de muitos outros desafios no esporte!
base_en: If you're starting in the world of popular races—a rewarding experience—it's essential to prepare properly to enjoy it to the fullest. Start with gradual training—without haste or unnecessary pressure—progressively increasing the distance and intensity of your sessions to avoid injuries—something very common if you're not careful. It's crucial to take care of your diet—essential fuel for your body—and ensure good hydration—drink water before, during, and after. Choose appropriate footwear—the investment is worth it—and comfortable clothing that allows you to move freely. During the race, maintain a consistent pace—don't start too fast—and listen to your body, without overexerting yourself. Enjoy the atmosphere and every kilometer covered—the finish line is just the beginning!

text_es: Restoring an antique piece of furniture is a job that, although detailed, is incredibly rewarding, as it seeks to return its original splendor without erasing its history. This process, which demands patience and knowledge, begins with a careful assessment to identify structural damage, termite infestation, or finish deterioration. Next, cleaning is a crucial step to remove layers of dirt or old varnishes, revealing the original wood. Structural repairs are made using glue or, if necessary, new parts, always with care to maintain the furniture's integrity. The final finish, which can be done with wax or oil, is chosen to protect the piece and enhance its beauty, allowing this furniture – a fact that testifies to the past – to continue its journey. Thus, with proper planning, the object, which can be found in an antique shop or a storage shed, regains its useful life. In the end, the piece of furniture is not just an item, but a living piece of history, which teaches us much about the type and style of its era.
text_tgt_raw: Restaurar uma peça de mobiliário antigo é um trabalho que, embora detalhista, é incrivelmente recompensador, pois busca devolver o esplendor original sem apagar sua história. Esse processo, que demanda paciência e conhecimento, começa com uma avaliação cuidadosa para identificar danos estruturais, infestação de cupins ou deterioração do acabamento. Em seguida, a limpeza é um passo crucial para remover camadas de sujeira ou vernizes antigos, revelando a madeira original. Reparos estruturais são feitos usando cola ou, se necessário, novas peças, sempre com o cuidado de manter a integridade do móvel. O acabamento final, que pode ser feito com cera ou óleo, é escolhido para proteger a peça e realçar sua beleza, permitindo que esse móvel – um fato que testemunha o passado – continue sua jornada. Assim, com um planejamento adequado, o objeto, que pode ser encontrado em um açougue de antiguidades ou em um galpão de armazenamento, recupera sua vida útil. No fim, a peça de mobiliário não é apenas um item, mas um pedaço vivo da história, que nos ensina muito sobre o gênero e o estilo de sua época.
base_en: Restoring an antique piece of furniture—a meticulous and rewarding task—involves a process that seeks to return it to its original splendor without altering its historical essence. This work—which requires patience and knowledge—begins with a thorough evaluation of the piece's condition—identifying structural damage, woodworm, or deterioration in the finish. Subsequently, cleaning proceeds—removing layers of dirt or old varnishes—to reveal the original wood. Structural repairs—such as gluing joints or replacing broken parts—are fundamental to ensuring the furniture's stability. Finally, a new finish is applied—respecting the era and style—which can be shellac, wax, or oil-based, protecting it and enhancing its beauty, thus allowing the furniture—a witness to the past—to continue telling its story for many more years.

text_es: To restore an antique piece of furniture—a very rewarding project that requires good planning—start by cleaning the surface with products specifically for wood. Next, assess the condition of the piece, identifying damage such as cracks or termite holes. If you find infestations, it is a fact that you will need to inject an anti-termite product, which is essential for the furniture's longevity. After that, sand the wood patiently, always along the grain, using progressively finer grit sandpaper. Finally, apply the finishing coat—wax, varnish, or paint, according to the desired style—and let it dry completely, following the manufacturer's instructions. It's a job that, although time-consuming, is very rewarding and economical compared to buying new furniture, and you will feel proud of your one-person team.
text_tgt_raw: Para restaurar um móvel antigo – um projeto bem gratificante, que exige um bom planejamento –, comece limpando a superfície com produtos específicos para madeira. Em seguida, avalie o estado da peça, identificando danos como rachaduras ou buracos de cupim. Se encontrar infestações, é um fato que você precisará injetar um produto anti-cupim, fundamental para a longevidade do móvel. Depois disso, lixe a madeira com paciência, sempre no sentido dos veios, usando lixas de grão progressivamente mais fino. Finalmente, aplique a camada de acabamento – cera, verniz ou tinta, conforme o estilo desejado – e deixe secar completamente, seguindo as instruções do fabricante. É um trabalho que, embora demorado, é muito recompensador e econômico se comparado a comprar um móvel novo, e você sentirá orgulho da sua equipe de uma pessoa.
base_en: To restore an antique piece of furniture—a rewarding project—start by thoroughly cleaning the surface—use specific wood products. Then, assess the condition of the piece—identify damage such as cracks or woodworm. If there are woodworm holes, inject an anti-woodworm product—it's vital for the furniture's longevity. Afterward, sand the wood patiently and in the direction of the grain—use progressively finer grit sandpaper. Once ready, apply the final coat—wax, varnish, or paint, depending on the desired style—and let it dry completely—follow the manufacturer's instructions. You'll enjoy the process and your renewed piece!

text_es: Organizing a birthday party, an event many consider memorable, requires planning and attention to detail. First, it's crucial to define the date and time, essential factors for guest attendance, and the number of people, ideally three or four weeks in advance so invitations can be sent. The choice of venue, whether at home or in a rented space, is another fundamental step that will depend on the available budget, an economic aspect to be seriously considered. Furthermore, it's necessary to define the theme, if there is one, the decoration, and the menu, which should include the cake and drinks. We cannot forget the music, a key element to create the atmosphere, and, if desired, activities or games to entertain the guest team, ensuring everyone enjoys themselves to the fullest. An interesting fact is that many people like to include good ice cream or natural juice to refresh.
text_tgt_raw: Organizar uma festa de aniversário, um evento que muitos consideram memorável, exige planejamento e atenção aos detalhes. Primeiramente, é crucial definir a data e a hora, fatores essenciais para a presença dos convidados, e o número de pessoas, idealmente com três ou quatro semanas de antecedência para que os convites possam ser enviados. A escolha do local, seja em casa ou em um espaço alugado, é outro passo fundamental que dependerá do orçamento disponível, um aspecto econômico a ser seriamente considerado. Além disso, é preciso definir o tema, se houver, a decoração, e o cardápio, que deve incluir o bolo e as bebidas. Não podemos esquecer da música, um elemento chave para criar a atmosfera, e, se desejado, atividades ou jogos para entreter a equipe de convidados, garantindo que todos desfrutem ao máximo. Um fato interessante é que muitas pessoas gostam de incluir um bom sorvete ou suco natural para refrescar.
base_en: Organizing a birthday party—a memorable event for many—requires planning and attention to detail. Initially, the date and time must be set—crucial factors for attendance—and the number of guests decided—ideally, 3, or 4 weeks in advance to send out invitations. The choice of venue—whether at home or a rented space—is another fundamental step that will depend on the available budget—an aspect to consider seriously. Additionally, the theme—if there's one—and the decoration must be defined, as well as the menu—including the cake, of course—and the drinks. Don't forget the music—a key element for the atmosphere—and, if desired, activities, or games to entertain attendees, ensuring everyone enjoys themselves to the fullest—the main goal of the celebration.

text_es: Organizing my sister's 10th birthday party was quite an adventure. I started with the guest list, a total of 15 children, and then I dedicated myself to the decorations, buying lots of colorful balloons and garlands. The biggest complication was the three-tier cake she wanted, as I had to order it two weeks in advance, which made me plan everything well ahead of time. On the day of the party, a sunny Saturday, everything went perfectly. There were many games, laughter, and the food—pizzas, sandwiches, and sweets—was an economic success. Seeing my sister's happy face, with that smile that was worth all the effort, made every detail pay off. It even seemed like a phenomenon of joy!
text_tgt_raw: Organizar a festa de 10 anos da minha irmã foi uma aventura e tanto. Comecei com a lista de convidados, um total de 15 crianças, e depois me dediquei às decorações, comprando muitos balões coloridos e guirlandas. A maior complicação foi o bolo de três andares que ela queria, pois tive que encomendá-lo com duas semanas de antecedência, o que me fez planejar tudo bem antes. No dia da festa, um sábado ensolarado, tudo correu perfeitamente. Houve muitos jogos, risadas e a comida – pizzas, sanduíches e doces – foi um sucesso econômico. Ver o rosto feliz da minha irmã, com aquele sorriso que valeu todo o esforço, fez cada detalhe compensar. Até pareceu um fenômeno de alegria!
base_en: Organizing my sister's 10th birthday party—she was turning 10—was an unexpected adventure. I started with a guest list—a total of 15 children—and then I dedicated myself to the decorations. I bought colorful balloons—many, helium, and regular—and garlands. The biggest complication was the cake—she wanted a 3-tier cake—since I had to order it 2 weeks in advance. On the day of the party—a sunny Saturday—everything went perfectly. There were games, laughter, and the food—pizzas, sandwiches, and many sweets—was a total success. Seeing my sister's happy face—her smile was worth all the effort—made every detail worthwhile.

text_es: To plan an unforgettable birthday party, it's essential to start organizing two or three weeks in advance. First, define the budget, the basis of everything, and the number of guests, a key factor. Next, choose the location – it can be at home, a rented space, or even outdoors – and the date and time, considering the availability of most people. Don't forget the theme, if you want one, the food, offering economical options for everyone, and the drinks, perhaps a good juice. Send out the invitations in advance so everyone can confirm their attendance, and prepare a list of activities or games, especially if there are children, such as a sports competition. An interesting fact is that good planning ensures less stress. Finally, relax and enjoy the day, after so much work, maybe even use your cell phone to record the best moments.
text_tgt_raw: Para planejar uma festa de aniversário inesquecível, é fundamental começar a organização com duas ou três semanas de antecedência. Primeiro, defina o orçamento, a base de tudo, e o número de convidados, um fator chave. Em seguida, escolha o local – pode ser em casa, um espaço alugado, ou até ao ar livre – e a data e hora, pensando na disponibilidade da maioria. Não se esqueça do tema, caso queira um, da comida, oferecendo opções econômicas para todos, e das bebidas, talvez um bom suco. Enviei os convites com antecedência para que todos possam confirmar a presença, e prepare uma lista de atividades ou jogos, principalmente se houver crianças, como uma disputa de esportes. Um fato interessante é que um bom planejamento garante menos estresse. Por último, relaxe e curta o dia, depois de tanto trabalho, talvez até use o celular para registrar os melhores momentos.
base_en: To organize a birthday party—a memorable event—it's crucial to start 2 or 3 weeks in advance. 1st, define the budget—the basis of everything—and the number of guests—a key factor. Then, choose the venue—at home, a rented place, or outdoors—and the date and time—considering the availability of most. Don't forget the theme—if you want one—the food—think of options for everyone—and the drinks. Send out invitations in advance—so they can confirm attendance—and prepare a list of activities or games—especially if there are children. Finally, relax, and enjoy the day—after so much work.

text_es: I've always been a bit bad at gardening, but since I moved into my new apartment – with more light, fortunately – I discovered the pleasure of caring for houseplants. I started with a pothos, very resilient, in fact, and little by little my small balcony filled with green. It's amazing how something so simple – watering, pruning, and fertilizing now and then – can bring so much calm and satisfaction. Every morning, the first thing I do, even before breakfast, is check on my little plants. I noticed that the atmosphere of my home, previously somewhat bland, improved a lot with them; even the air seems, subjectively, of course, fresher. Now I already have 7 plants and I'm thinking of adding a few more, maybe a fiddle-leaf fig, which is a challenge to care for. It's an economical hobby that brings a bonus of well-being.
text_tgt_raw: Sempre fui um pouco ruim com jardinagem, mas desde que me mudei para meu novo apartamento – com mais luz, felizmente – descobri o prazer de cuidar de plantas de interior. Comecei com um pothos, bem resistente, de fato, e aos poucos minha pequena varanda foi se enchendo de verde. É incrível como algo tão simples – regar, podar e adubar de vez em quando – pode trazer tanta calma e satisfação. Toda manhã, a primeira coisa que faço, mesmo antes do café da manhã, é verificar minhas plantinhas. Notei que a atmosfera da minha casa, antes um tanto sem graça, melhorou muito com elas; até o ar parece, subjetivamente, claro, mais fresco. Agora já tenho 7 plantas e estou pensando em adicionar mais algumas, talvez uma figueira-lira, que é um esporte de cuidar. É um hobby econômico e que traz um bônus de bem-estar.
base_en: I've always been—a bit—bad at gardening, but since I moved to my new apartment—with more light, fortunately—I've discovered the pleasure of caring for houseplants. I started with a pothos—quite resilient, actually—and little by little my small balcony has filled with green. It's incredible how something so simple—watering, pruning, and fertilizing now and then—can bring so much calm and satisfaction. Every morning, the 1st thing I do—even before coffee—is check on my little ones. I've noticed that the atmosphere of my home—previously a bit bland—has improved a lot with them; even the air feels—subjectively, of course—fresher. Now I already have 7 plants and I'm thinking of adding a couple more—a fiddle-leaf fig, perhaps.

text_es: To begin caring for your indoor plants, a rewarding task, it's essential to know their specific needs. Research the amount of light each species requires—direct or indirect—to place them in the right spot in your home. Watering is a crucial factor: not too much, not too little. Always check the soil moisture with your finger before adding more water and only water when the top 1 or 2 inches are dry. It's also important to choose pots with good drainage—with holes in the bottom—to prevent water accumulation, one of the main causes of death. Consider ambient humidity, especially in winter, and periodic fertilization every 2 or 3 months to encourage economical and healthy growth. Finally, pay attention to potential pests and intervene quickly to protect the health of your plants.
text_tgt_raw: Para começar a cuidar das suas plantas de interior, uma tarefa gratificante, é fundamental conhecer suas necessidades específicas. Pesquise a quantidade de luz que cada espécie precisa — direta ou indireta — para posicioná-las no lugar certo em sua casa. A rega é um fato crucial: nem muito, nem pouco. Sempre verifique a umidade do solo com o dedo antes de adicionar mais água e regue apenas quando os primeiros 2 ou 3 cm estiverem secos. É importante também escolher vasos com boa drenagem — com furos no fundo — para evitar o acúmulo de água, uma das principais causas de morte. Considere a umidade ambiente, especialmente no inverno, e a fertilização periódica a cada 2 ou 3 meses para estimular um crescimento econômico e saudável. Por fim, preste atenção a possíveis pragas e intervenha rapidamente para proteger a saúde das suas plantas.
base_en: To start caring for your indoor plants—a rewarding task—it's essential to know their specific needs. Make sure to research the amount of light each species requires—direct or indirect—to place them in the right spot in your home. Watering is crucial—neither too much nor too little: always check the soil's moisture with your finger before adding more water and only water when the 1st 2 or 3 cm are dry. It's also important to choose pots with good drainage—with holes in the bottom—to prevent waterlogging, which is one of the main causes of death. Consider ambient humidity—especially in winter—and periodic fertilization—every 2 or 3 months—to encourage healthy growth. Finally, pay attention to possible pests—like spider mites—and intervene quickly to protect the health of your plants.

text_es: Choosing a good mattress is crucial for ensuring restorative sleep and good postural health, something essential for the back. There are several types on the market, from spring mattresses to memory foam ones, each with specific characteristics that adapt to different needs and preferences. It is vital to consider the firmness level—neither too soft nor excessively hard—the material, which should be breathable, and the size, appropriate for the dimensions of the bed and the user. Furthermore, factors such as the person's body weight, whether the user sleeps alone or with a partner, and the usual sleeping position—on the back, side, or stomach—significantly influence the final decision. Trying out the mattress for a few minutes, even in different positions, is indispensable before making the purchase to ensure an economical and correct choice. Investing in a quality mattress, although it may seem like a high expense initially, is an investment in long-term well-being.
text_tgt_raw: Escolher um bom colchão é um fato crucial para garantir um sono reparador e uma boa saúde postural, algo essencial para as costas. Existem vários tipos no mercado, desde os de molas até os de espuma viscoelástica, cada um com características específicas que se adaptam a diferentes necessidades e preferências. É vital considerar o nível de firmeza — nem muito macio, nem excessivamente duro —, o material, que deve ser respirável, e o tamanho, apropriado para as dimensões da cama e do usuário. Além disso, fatores como o peso corporal da pessoa, se o usuário dorme sozinho ou acompanhado, e a postura usual de dormir — de costas, de lado ou de bruços — influenciam significativamente a decisão final. Experimentar o colchão por alguns minutos, até em diferentes posições, é indispensável antes de fazer a compra para assegurar uma escolha econômica e correta. Investir em um colchão de qualidade, embora possa parecer uma despesa elevada inicialmente, é um investimento em bem-estar a longo prazo.
base_en: Choosing a good mattress is essential to ensure restful sleep and good postural health—a crucial aspect for the back. There are various types of mattresses on the market—from springs to memory foam—each with particular characteristics that adapt to different needs and preferences. It's important to consider the level of firmness—neither too soft nor excessively hard—the material—which should be breathable—and the size—appropriate for the dimensions of the bed and the sleeper. In addition, factors such as the user's body weight—a detail often underestimated—whether one sleeps alone or with a partner, and the usual sleeping posture—on one's back, side, or stomach—significantly influence the final decision. Trying the mattress for a few minutes—even in different positions—is indispensable before making the purchase to ensure a correct choice. Investing in a quality mattress—although it may seem like a high expense initially—is an investment in long-term well-being.

text_es: The decision to choose a mattress—something that seemed so simple—turned into a real odyssey for me. After 15 years with the same one, I thought it was time to replace it, but I had no idea how many options awaited me. I visited at least five specialized stores, some with very insistent salespeople, and spent hours reading online reviews, which only increased my confusion. I even thought about giving up, but my plan for a good night's sleep was essential. In the end, I opted for a memory foam one, which after three nights of testing—a decisive factor—convinced me with its firmness and adaptability. The fact is that now I sleep like a baby, and I don't regret the investment. My comfort is economical, as it avoids future expenses with back problems. I keep thinking that a good mattress is a phenomenon everyone should experience to improve their well-being.
text_tgt_raw: A decisão de escolher um colchão – algo que parecia tão simples – virou uma verdadeira odisseia para mim. Depois de 15 anos com o mesmo, achei que era hora de trocar, mas não fazia ideia da quantidade de opções que me esperavam. Visitei ao menos cinco lojas especializadas, algumas com vendedores bastante insistentes, e passei horas lendo avaliações online, o que só aumentou minha confusão. Cheguei a pensar em desistir, mas meu planejamento de uma boa noite de sono era fundamental. No fim, optei por um de espuma viscoelástica, que após três noites de teste – um fator decisivo – me convenceu com sua firmeza e adaptabilidade. O fato é que agora durmo como um bebê, e não me arrependo do investimento. Meu conforto é econômico, pois evita gastos futuros com problemas de coluna. Fico pensando que um colchão bom é um fenômeno que todo mundo deveria experimentar para melhorar o bem-estar.
base_en: The decision to choose a mattress—and it seems so simple—became an unexpected odyssey for me. After 15 years using the same one, I decided it was time for a change, but I didn't know the number of options—hundreds!—that awaited me. I visited at least 5 specialized stores—some with very insistent salespeople—and spent hours reading reviews online, which only increased my confusion. In the end, I opted for a memory foam one—or so they promised me—which, after 3 nights of testing—a decisive factor—convinced me with its firmness and adaptability. Now, finally, I sleep like a baby—the truth is it's wonderful—and I don't regret the investment.

text_es: When choosing a mattress, a crucial decision for your rest, first consider the type of firmness that best suits your sleeping position. If you sleep on your back, the most common position, a medium-firm mattress may be ideal, offering support without excessive rigidity. For side sleepers, to avoid pressure on the shoulders and hips, a softer, more adaptable mattress, like a memory foam one, is often the best option. Don't forget to test the mattress in the store for at least 10 or 15 minutes, not just sit on it, to make sure it's truly comfortable for you. Also check the materials, which is important for allergies or sensitivities, and the warranties offered by manufacturers, an indicator of quality. A good mattress is a fact that can last between 8 and 10 years, a long-term investment, so planning your choice is economical. Good planning for this acquisition is essential, and contacting specialists can help manage this decision. A quality mattress is not a naive item, but rather an essential comfort for daily well-being, contributing to your health and disposition.
text_tgt_raw: Ao escolher um colchão, uma decisão crucial para seu descanso, considere primeiro o tipo de firmeza que melhor se adapta à sua posição de dormir. Se você dorme de costas, a posição mais comum, um colchão de firmeza média pode ser ideal, oferecendo suporte sem rigidez excessiva. Para quem dorme de lado, evitando pressão nos ombros e quadris, um colchão mais macio e adaptável, como um de espuma viscoelástica, é frequentemente a melhor opção. Não se esqueça de testar o colchão na loja por pelo menos 10 ou 15 minutos, não apenas sentar-se, para ter certeza de que é realmente confortável para você. Verifique também os materiais, importante para alergias ou sensibilidades, e as garantias oferecidas pelos fabricantes, um indicador de qualidade. Um bom colchão é um fato que pode durar entre 8 e 10 anos, um investimento de longo prazo, então planejar a escolha é econômico. É fundamental um bom planejamento para essa aquisição, e um contato com especialistas pode ajudar a gerenciar essa decisão. Um colchão de qualidade não é um item ingênuo, mas sim um cômodo essencial para o bem-estar diário, contribuindo para a sua saúde e disposição.
base_en: When choosing a mattress—an important decision for your rest—consider 1st the type of firmness that best suits your sleeping posture. If you sleep on your back—the most common position—a medium-firm mattress could be ideal, offering support without excessive rigidity. For those who sleep on their side—thus avoiding pressure on shoulders and hips—a softer, more adaptable mattress, like a memory foam one, is often the best option. Don't forget to try the mattress in the store for at least 10 or 15 minutes—don't just sit on it—to make sure it's really comfortable for you. Also check the materials—important for allergies or sensitivities—and the warranties offered by manufacturers—an indicator of quality. A good mattress can last between 8 and 10 years—a long-term investment—so take your time to choose well.

text_es: Reducing food waste, a global phenomenon of great magnitude, is crucial for the planet's sustainability and food security. It is estimated that one-third of all food produced annually is lost or wasted—about 1.3 billion tons—which leads to serious economic, social, and environmental implications. Combating this problem involves adopting more conscious consumption habits, such as planning purchases and using leftovers, storing food properly to extend its shelf life, and understanding expiration dates well. The role of the food industry, from production to distribution, is fundamental in optimizing its processes and minimizing losses, as are public policies that encourage the donation of food still in good condition. Every small individual gesture, such as not discarding edible food, contributes to a positive collective impact, a fact we cannot ignore.
text_tgt_raw: Reduzir o desperdício alimentar, um fenômeno global de grande magnitude, é crucial para a sustentabilidade do planeta e a segurança alimentar. Estima-se que um terço de toda a comida produzida anualmente seja perdida ou desperdiçada – cerca de 1,3 bilhão de toneladas – o que acarreta sérias implicações econômicas, sociais e ambientais. Combater esse problema envolve a adoção de hábitos de consumo mais conscientes, como planejar as compras e utilizar sobras, armazenar alimentos adequadamente para estender sua vida útil e compreender bem as datas de validade. O papel da indústria alimentícia, da produção à distribuição, é fundamental para otimizar seus processos e minimizar perdas, assim como políticas públicas que incentivem a doação de alimentos ainda em boas condições. Cada pequeno gesto individual, como não descartar comida própria para consumo, contribui para um impacto coletivo positivo, um fato que não podemos ignorar.
base_en: Reducing food waste—a global problem of great magnitude—is crucial for the planet's sustainability and food security. It's estimated that 1/3 of all food produced annually is lost or wasted—approximately 1.3 billion tons—which has serious economic, social, and environmental implications. Combating this involves adopting more conscious consumption habits—such as planning purchases and utilizing surpluses—properly storing food to extend its shelf life—thus preventing its premature spoilage—and thoroughly understanding expiration and best-by dates. The role of the food industry—from production to distribution—is also fundamental in optimizing its processes and minimizing losses, as are public policies that encourage the donation of food suitable for consumption. Every small individual gesture—like not discarding food in good condition—contributes to a positive collective impact.

text_es: Ever since I started becoming more aware of the environmental impact of our actions a few years ago, reducing food waste has become a priority in my home. I remember one time I organized a dinner for eight friends, which is always a culinary challenge, and ended up with leftovers for three days, a fact that left me quite upset. From then on, I started planning menus in advance and with much more precision, buying only what was necessary, avoiding impulse purchases, which are my weakness, I confess. I also adopted the habit of creatively reusing leftovers; a simple stew can turn into croquettes the next day. The truth is, I discovered a hidden, economical talent for ingenious cooking. I firmly believe that small changes in our daily habits, however insignificant they may seem, can make a big difference. Today, when I see leftover food, I think: "How can I give this a second life?", a question I love to answer and which often leads me to a tasty meal, like a fruit juice made with what was left in the fruit bowl or a hearty breakfast.
text_tgt_raw: Desde que comecei a ficar mais consciente do impacto ambiental de nossas ações, há alguns anos, reduzir o desperdício de alimentos se tornou uma prioridade em minha casa. Lembro-me de uma vez que organizei um jantar para oito amigos, o que sempre é um desafio culinário, e acabei com sobras para três dias, um fato que me deixou bastante chateado. A partir daí, comecei a planejar os cardápios com antecedência e com muito mais precisão, comprando apenas o necessário, evitando as compras por impulso, que são meu ponto fraco, confesso. Adotei também o hábito de reutilizar as sobras de forma criativa; um simples ensopado pode se transformar em croquetes no dia seguinte. A verdade é que descobri um talento econômico e escondido para cozinhar de forma engenhosa. Acredito firmemente que pequenas mudanças em nossos hábitos diários, por mais insignificantes que pareçam, podem fazer uma grande diferença. Hoje, quando vejo que sobrou comida, penso: "Como posso dar uma segunda vida a isso?", uma pergunta que adoro responder e que, muitas vezes, me leva a uma refeição saborosa, tipo um suco de frutas feito com o que sobrou da fruteira ou um café da manhã reforçado.
base_en: Ever since I started becoming more aware—some years ago now—of the environmental impact of our actions, reducing food waste has become a priority in my home. I remember 1 time I organized a dinner for 8 friends—which is always a culinary challenge—and ended up with leftovers for 3 days, something that made me feel terrible. From then on, I started planning menus in advance—and with much more precision—and buying only what was necessary, thus avoiding impulse purchases—which are my downfall, I confess. I've also adopted the habit of creatively reusing leftovers—a simple stew can be transformed into croquettes the next day—and the truth is, I discovered a hidden talent for resourceful cooking. I firmly believe that small changes in our daily habits—however insignificant they may seem—can make a big difference. Now, when I see that there's some food left, I think, "How can I give this a 2nd life?"—a question I enjoy answering.

text_es: To combat food waste, a concerning global phenomenon, planning is crucial. Start by planning your meals in advance and making a well-thought-out shopping list so you don't buy unnecessary items and can be more economical. It's a fact that how we store food directly impacts its shelf life; separating fruits and vegetables correctly, for example, is a small gesture with a big impact. Check your refrigerator and pantry regularly to use older products first. If you have leftover fresh ingredients, such as vegetables that are starting to wilt, consider freezing them or turning them into soups or broths. Creative use of leftovers in other meals not only saves money but also minimizes the disposal of valuable food. Furthermore, managing portion sizes, especially for few people, prevents excess food, and if there are still leftovers, sharing or composting are great ecological alternatives.
text_tgt_raw: Para combater o desperdício alimentar, um fenômeno global preocupante, o planejamento é crucial. Comece planejando suas refeições com antecedência e fazendo uma lista de compras bem pensada para não comprar itens desnecessários e ser mais econômico. É fato que a forma como armazenamos os alimentos impacta diretamente sua durabilidade; separar frutas e vegetais corretamente, por exemplo, é um pequeno gesto com grande impacto. Verifique a geladeira e a despensa regularmente para usar os produtos mais antigos primeiro. Se tiver sobras de ingredientes frescos, como vegetais que estão começando a murchar, considere congelá-los ou transformá-los em sopas ou caldos. O uso criativo de sobras em outras refeições não só economiza dinheiro, mas também minimiza o descarte de alimentos valiosos. Além disso, gerenciar o tamanho das porções, especialmente para poucas pessoas, evita o excesso de comida e, caso ainda haja sobras, compartilhar ou compostar são ótimas alternativas ecológicas.
base_en: To reduce food waste—a serious global problem—start by planning your meals in advance, making a shopping list—only of what you need—and sticking to it strictly to avoid impulse purchases. It's essential to store food correctly—separating fruits and vegetables according to their needs—to prolong its shelf life, and to regularly check the fridge and pantry to use the oldest products 1st. If you've leftover fresh ingredients—for example, vegetables that are starting to wilt—think about freezing them or turning them into broths, soups, or stews. Also, use leftovers—creatively, of course—in other meals; this way you not only save money, but you also minimize the waste of valuable food. Also consider portion sizes—especially when cooking for 1 or 2 people—to avoid overcooking, and if you still have leftovers, share them or think about composting—an excellent ecological option—as a 3rd alternative.

text_es: Learning to swim as an adult is a rewarding, though sometimes challenging, experience that offers numerous benefits for physical and mental health. Many people, for various reasons, did not have the opportunity to learn in childhood, but adulthood is not an impediment to acquiring this vital skill. Courses for adults usually focus on overcoming the fear of water – a common obstacle – and on developing basic flotation and propulsion techniques. With patience and constant practice, usually two or three sessions per week, it is possible to make significant academic progress in a short time. In addition to being a survival skill, swimming is a low-impact sport, ideal for joints, and an excellent way to release stress, which improves overall well-being. No matter the age, it's never too late to start; swimming opens up a world of opportunities for leisure and social contact. It is an economical and pleasurable activity that can be practiced by anyone, without the need for complex electronic equipment or even a truck to transport the material.
text_tgt_raw: Aprender a nadar na vida adulta é uma experiência gratificante, embora às vezes desafiadora, que oferece inúmeros benefícios para a saúde física e mental. Muitas pessoas, por diversos fatos, não tiveram a oportunidade de aprender na infância, mas a vida adulta não é um impedimento para adquirir essa habilidade vital. Os cursos para adultos geralmente focam em superar o medo da água – um obstáculo comum – e no desenvolvimento de técnicas básicas de flutuação e propulsão. Com paciência e prática constante, geralmente duas ou três sessões por semana, é possível fazer um progresso acadêmico significativo em pouco tempo. Além de ser uma habilidade de sobrevivência, a natação é um esporte de baixo impacto, ideal para as articulações, e uma excelente maneira de liberar o estresse, o que melhora o bem-estar geral. Não importa a idade, nunca é tarde para começar; nadar abre um mundo de oportunidades para lazer e contato social. É uma atividade econômica e prazerosa, que pode ser praticada por qualquer um, sem a necessidade de um equipamento eletrônico complexo ou mesmo de um caminhão para transportar o material.
base_en: Learning to swim as an adult is a rewarding—though sometimes challenging—experience that offers numerous benefits for physical and mental health. Many people—for various reasons—didn't have the opportunity to learn in childhood, but adulthood isn't an impediment to acquiring this vital skill. Courses for adults usually focus on overcoming the fear of water—a common obstacle—and on developing basic floating and propulsion techniques. With patience and constant practice—generally 2 or 3 sessions per week—significant progress can be made in a short time. In addition to being a survival skill, swimming is a low-impact exercise—ideal for the joints—and an excellent way to release stress—which improves overall well-being. No matter the age—it's never too late to start—swimming opens up a world of opportunities for leisure and sport.

text_es: Last year, at 35 — a somewhat advanced age to start — I decided it was time to learn to swim. I had always avoided water, even in summer, and this phobia greatly limited me on vacations, especially at the beach. I enrolled in swimming lessons with a group of adults, all with our fears, at the municipal pool. At first it was frustrating and a little embarrassing, a fact that made me feel a bit self-conscious. My instructor, a very patient man with decades of experience, encouraged me to continue. He was phenomenal, always motivating us. After three months of effort, I managed to float and do my first strokes — an incredible feeling! Now I enjoy the water, I even try some backstrokes, and I'm thinking of signing up for some water sport. On the weekend, after a hearty breakfast, I go to the pool and have an ice cream afterward.
text_tgt_raw: No ano passado, aos 35 anos — uma idade um tanto avançada para começar —, decidi que era hora de aprender a nadar. Sempre evitei a água, mesmo no verão, e essa fobia me limitava muito nas férias, especialmente na praia. Matriculei-me em aulas de natação com um grupo de adultos, todos com nossos medos, na piscina municipal. No começo foi frustrante e um pouco embaraçoso, um fato que me deixava um pouco constrangido. Meu instrutor, um homem muito paciente com décadas de experiência, me encorajou a continuar. Ele era um fenômeno, sempre nos motivando. Depois de três meses de esforço, consegui flutuar e fazer minhas primeiras braçadas — uma sensação incrível! Agora aproveito a água, até arrisco alguns nados de costas e penso em me inscrever em alguma modalidade de esporte aquático. No final de semana, depois de um café da manhã reforçado, vou à piscina e tomo um sorvete depois.
base_en: Last year, at 35 years old—a somewhat advanced age to start—I decided it was time to learn how to swim. I had always avoided water—even in summer—and that phobia greatly limited me on vacations—especially at the beach. I signed up for swimming lessons with a group of adults—all with our fears—at the municipal pool. At 1st it was frustrating—and a little embarrassing—but my instructor, a very patient man—with decades of experience—encouraged me to continue. After 3 months of effort, I managed to float and do my 1st laps—an incredible feeling! Now I enjoy the water and even dare to do some backstrokes.

text_es: If you are thinking about learning to swim as an adult, a fundamental and very beneficial skill, it is essential to start with specialized lessons. Look for a good instructor, someone patient and experienced, who knows how to deal with the fear of water, a common phenomenon among adults. Start in the shallow end of the pool, where you will feel safer, and familiarize yourself with breathing and floating before attempting more complex movements. Consistency is key: practice regularly to solidify your progress and don't get discouraged if you don't see immediate results; everyone has their own pace. Collect tips on arm stroke and leg kick techniques; there are many online resources that can help you, and you will see that, with time and effort, you will master the water and enjoy all its benefits, both physical and mental, which go far beyond good economic conditioning. Perhaps afterward you might even start practicing some water sport.
text_tgt_raw: Se você está pensando em aprender a nadar na vida adulta, uma habilidade fundamental e muito benéfica, é essencial começar com aulas especializadas. Procure um bom instrutor, alguém paciente e com experiência, que saiba lidar com o medo da água, um fenômeno comum entre adultos. Comece na parte rasa da piscina, onde você se sentirá mais seguro, e familiarize-se com a respiração e a flutuação antes de tentar movimentos mais complexos. A consistência é fundamental: pratique regularmente para solidificar seu progresso e não desanime se não vir resultados imediatos; cada um tem seu próprio ritmo. Colete dicas sobre técnicas de braçada e pernada, há muitos arquivos online que podem te ajudar, e você verá que, com tempo e esforço, dominará a água e desfrutará de todos os seus benefícios, tanto físicos quanto mentais, que vão muito além de um bom condicionamento econômico. Talvez depois você até comece a praticar algum esporte aquático.
base_en: If you're thinking about learning to swim as an adult—a fundamental and enriching skill—it's crucial to start with specialized classes. Look for a good instructor—someone with patience and experience—who knows how to handle fear of water, something very common in adults. Start in the shallow end of the pool—where you feel safe—and familiarize yourself with breathing and floating before attempting more complex movements. Consistency is key—practice regularly to solidify your progress—and don't get discouraged if you don't see immediate results; everyone has their own pace. Gather tips on kicking and stroking techniques—there are many online resources that can help you—and you'll see that, with time and effort, you'll master the water and enjoy all its benefits—both physical and mental.

text_es: Painting a room is a relatively simple home improvement project that can completely transform the look of a space, bringing a new atmosphere and brightness. Before starting, it's essential to plan the room's preparation—covering furniture and floors—to avoid paint splatters, a key factor for a good finish. The choice of paint color, an important aesthetic factor, will influence the perception of the room's size and lighting, so it's advisable to test samples to ensure the desired shade. After preparation, primer is applied, if necessary, to ensure better adhesion and uniformity of the final color, especially on new or very porous surfaces. Finally, two or three coats of paint are applied, respecting the recommended drying time between them, usually several hours, to achieve a professional and long-lasting finish.
text_tgt_raw: Pintar um cômodo é um projeto de melhoria doméstica relativamente simples que pode transformar completamente o visual de um espaço, trazendo uma nova atmosfera e luminosidade. Antes de começar, é fundamental planejar a preparação do ambiente — cobrindo móveis e pisos — para evitar respingos de tinta, um fato chave para um bom acabamento. A escolha da cor da tinta, um fator estético importante, influenciará a percepção do tamanho e da iluminação do cômodo, sendo aconselhável testar amostras para garantir o tom desejado. Após a preparação, aplica-se o primer, se necessário, para assegurar melhor adesão e uniformidade da cor final, especialmente em superfícies novas ou muito porosas. Finalmente, aplicam-se duas ou três demãos de tinta, respeitando o tempo de secagem recomendado entre elas, normalmente várias horas, para obter um acabamento profissional e duradouro.
base_en: Painting a room is a relatively simple home improvement project that can completely transform the look of a space, bringing a new atmosphere and brightness. Before starting, it's essential to prepare the room—covering furniture and floors—to avoid paint splatters, a key step for a good finish. The choice of paint color—an important aesthetic factor—will influence the perception of the room's size and lighting, making it advisable to test samples to ensure the desired shade. After preparation, primer is applied—if necessary—to ensure better adhesion and uniformity of the final color, especially on new or very porous surfaces. Finally, 2, or 3 coats of paint are applied, allowing the recommended drying time between them—normally several hours—to obtain a professional and durable finish.

text_es: Two months ago, I decided it was time to paint my room. The fact is that the wall had a very ugly color, a shade that reminded me of elementary school. I bought the paint — a beautiful off-white — and all the necessary tools, convinced that it would be an economical task. The first day was easy, but on the second, my arms couldn't take it anymore — I'm a bit lazy, I admit. Fortunately, my sister came to help me — she is much more skilled than I am — and, between the two of us, we finished in three afternoons. The final result, with 90% of her effort, to be honest, was spectacular, and the room looks completely different, much brighter and cozier. Now all that's left is to enjoy it and not get the walls dirty, maybe even some ice cream to celebrate!
text_tgt_raw: Dois meses atrás, decidi que era hora de pintar meu quarto. O fato é que a parede tinha uma cor bem feia, um tom que me lembrava o ensino fundamental. Comprei a tinta — um lindo branco-gelo — e todas as ferramentas necessárias, convencida de que seria uma tarefa econômica. O primeiro dia foi tranquilo, mas no segundo, meus braços já não aguentavam mais — sou um pouco preguiçosa, admito. Felizmente, minha irmã veio me ajudar — ela é bem mais habilidosa que eu — e, entre nós duas, terminamos em três tardes. O resultado final, com 90% do esforço dela, para ser honesta, foi espetacular, e o cômodo parece completamente diferente, muito mais claro e aconchegante. Agora só me resta aproveitar e não sujar as paredes, talvez até um sorvete para celebrar!
base_en: 2 months ago, I decided it was time to paint my bedroom. The truth—and I'm not saying this to discourage anyone—is that the wall had a pretty ugly color, a shade that reminded me of 1st grade. I bought the paint—a beautiful off-white—and all the necessary tools, convinced it would be an easy task. The 1st day went well, but by the 2nd day, my arms couldn't take it anymore—I'm a bit lazy, I admit. Fortunately, my sister came to help me—she's handier than I'm—and between the 2 of us, we finished it in 3 afternoons. The final result—with 90% of her effort, honestly—was spectacular, and the room looks completely different, much brighter and cozier—we did it, yes. Now all that's left is to enjoy it—and not get the walls dirty.

text_es: When starting to paint a room, a rewarding task that can be quite economical, the first step is good planning. Make sure you have all your materials, such as paint, brushes, rollers, and painter's tape, on hand before you begin. It's a fact that surface preparation is crucial: clean the walls, fix imperfections, and protect the floor and furniture with drop cloths. Use good quality painter's tape to define the edges of ceilings, baseboards, and door and window frames, as cheap tape can ruin the job. Apply two coats of paint—or three, if the color is very different—for a uniform and durable finish. Don't forget to ventilate the space well during and after painting, as your health comes first. Finally, calmly managing your time is essential; there's no bonus for rushing.
text_tgt_raw: Ao iniciar a pintura de um cômodo, uma tarefa gratificante e que pode ser bastante econômica, o primeiro passo é um bom planejamento. Certifique-se de ter todos os materiais, como tinta, pincéis, rolos e fita crepe, em mãos antes de começar. É um fato que a preparação da superfície é crucial: limpe as paredes, corrija imperfeições e proteja o piso e os móveis com lonas. Use fita crepe de boa qualidade para definir as bordas de tetos, rodapés e batentes de portas e janelas, pois fitas baratas podem estragar o trabalho. Aplique duas demãos de tinta — ou três, se a cor for muito diferente — para um acabamento uniforme e duradouro. Não se esqueça de ventilar bem o espaço durante e depois da pintura, pois sua saúde vem em primeiro lugar. Finalmente, gerenciar o tempo com calma é essencial; não há bônus por pressa.
base_en: When you start painting a room—a rewarding task—the 1st thing is good planning. Make sure you've all the materials—paint, brushes, rollers, painter's tape, protective plastic sheets—on hand before you begin. Prepare the surface well—clean the walls, repair any imperfections—and protect the floor and furniture with drop cloths. Use good quality painter's tape—cheap tape can peel off paint—to define the edges of ceilings, baseboards, and door and window frames. Apply 2 coats of paint—or 3, if the color is very different—for a uniform and durable finish. Don't forget to ventilate the space well—health comes 1st—during and after painting. Finally, take your time—haste isn't a good advisor—and enjoy the process.

text_es: Starting to meditate, an ancient practice, involves dedicating time to train the mind to achieve a state of mindfulness and deep relaxation. No prior experience is needed—anyone can start—and the benefits can be noticed in a short time. The ideal is to find a quiet place, free from distractions, and establish a comfortable posture, whether sitting or lying down. You can start with short sessions, 5 to 10 minutes a day, and gradually increase the duration as you feel more comfortable with the process. The fact is that the main goal is to observe thoughts without judging them, simply letting them pass, and focusing on breathing as an anchor. This regular practice, which benefits body and mind, can reduce stress, improve concentration, and promote greater self-awareness, a phenomenon increasingly studied. You don't need a cell phone for this, just a few minutes of silence to create a daily record of well-being. It's a sport for the mind, accessible and economical.
text_tgt_raw: Começar a meditar, uma prática ancestral, envolve dedicar tempo para treinar a mente a alcançar um estado de atenção plena e relaxamento profundo. Não é preciso experiência prévia — qualquer um pode começar — e os benefícios podem ser notados em pouco tempo. O ideal é encontrar um lugar tranquilo, livre de distrações, e estabelecer uma postura confortável, seja sentado ou deitado. Você pode começar com sessões curtas, de 5 a 10 minutos por dia, e aumentar gradualmente a duração conforme se sentir mais à vontade com o processo. O fato é que o objetivo principal é observar os pensamentos sem julgá-los, simplesmente deixando-os passar, e focar na respiração como uma âncora. Essa prática regular, que beneficia corpo e mente, pode reduzir o estresse, melhorar a concentração e promover um maior autoconhecimento, um fenômeno cada vez mais estudado. Você não precisa de um celular para isso, apenas de alguns minutos de silêncio para criar um registro de bem-estar diário. É um esporte para a mente, acessível e econômico.
base_en: Starting to meditate—an ancient practice—involves dedicating time to train the mind to achieve a state of mindfulness and deep relaxation. No prior experience is required—anyone can start—and the benefits can be noticeable in a short time. The ideal is to find a quiet place—free from distractions—and establish a comfortable posture, either sitting or lying down. You can start with short sessions—5 to 10 minutes a day—and gradually increase the duration as you feel more comfortable with the process. The main goal is to observe thoughts without judging them—simply letting them pass—and focusing on the breath as an anchor. This regular practice—which benefits body and mind—can reduce stress, improve concentration, and foster greater self-awareness.

text_es: I remember my first attempt at meditating, five years ago, was a total disaster. I sat on the floor, on a very uncomfortable cushion, with the idea of relaxing, but my mind seemed like a party. Thoughts about the grocery list—which I had forgotten to plan and didn't know if I had milk!—pending work, and even the melody of a catchy song I hated, crowded in non-stop. I tried to focus on my breathing, a budget-friendly tip I had read on a blog, but each inhale and exhale felt forced. After about 10 minutes, which felt like two hours, I gave up, frustrated and more stressed than before. I thought meditating wasn't for me, a fairly common fact, I suppose, but I decided to give it another try the next day, before catching the bus.
text_tgt_raw: Lembro-me que minha primeira tentativa de meditar, há cinco anos, foi um desastre total. Sentei-me no chão, em uma almofada bem desconfortável, com a ideia de relaxar, mas minha mente parecia uma festa. Pensamentos sobre a lista de compras — que eu tinha esquecido de planejar e não sabia se tinha leite! — o trabalho pendente, e até a melodia de uma música chiclete que eu detestava, se aglomeravam sem parar. Tentei focar na minha respiração, uma dica econômica que tinha lido em um blog, mas cada inalação e exalação parecia forçada. Após uns 10 minutos, que pareceram duas horas, desisti, frustrado e mais estressado que antes. Achei que meditar não era para mim, um fato bastante comum, suponho, mas decidi dar outra chance no dia seguinte, antes de pegar o ônibus.
base_en: I remember that my 1st attempt to meditate—5 years ago now—was an absolute disaster. I sat on the floor—on a rather uncomfortable cushion—with the idea of relaxing, but my mind seemed to be having a party. Thoughts about the shopping list—what a disaster, I couldn't remember if I had milk!—the pending work, and even the melody of a catchy song—the one I hated, too—crowded in incessantly. I tried to focus on my breathing—a tip I had read on a blog—but each inhalation and exhalation felt forced. After about 10 minutes—which felt like 2 hours—I gave up, frustrated, and more stressed than before. I thought that meditation wasn't for me—a pretty common idea, I suppose—but I decided to give it another chance the next day.

text_es: To begin meditation, a habit with economic benefits for the mind and body, find a quiet place where you won't be interrupted. Sit comfortably, whether in a chair or on a cushion, with your spine straight but relaxed. Focus on your breath, the anchor of your practice, feeling the air enter and exit. Don't get frustrated if your mind wanders; it's a completely normal fact at the beginning. Just gently redirect your attention back to your breath whenever that happens. Start with short sessions, 5 or 10 minutes, and gradually increase the duration until you reach 20 or 30 minutes a day, when you feel more comfortable. The key is consistency, not perfection; even practicing three times a week makes a difference. Each session is an opportunity to cultivate mindfulness and manage stress, such a common phenomenon nowadays. It's like taking a bus to a destination of inner peace. You can even have some juice or breakfast beforehand to prepare yourself.
text_tgt_raw: Para iniciar a meditação, um hábito com benefícios econômicos para a mente e o corpo, procure um local tranquilo onde não será interrompido. Sente-se confortavelmente, seja em uma cadeira ou almofada, com a coluna reta, mas relaxada. Concentre-se na sua respiração, a âncora da sua prática, sentindo o ar entrar e sair. Não se frustre se sua mente divagar; é um fato completamente normal no início. Apenas redirecione gentilmente sua atenção de volta à respiração sempre que isso acontecer. Comece com sessões curtas, de 5 ou 10 minutos, e aumente gradualmente a duração até chegar a 20 ou 30 minutos por dia, quando se sentir mais à vontade. A chave é a consistência, não a perfeição; mesmo praticar três vezes por semana já faz uma diferença. Cada sessão é uma oportunidade para cultivar a atenção plena e gerenciar o estresse, um fenômeno tão comum hoje em dia. É como pegar um ônibus para um destino de paz interior. Você pode até tomar um suco ou café da manhã antes para se preparar.
base_en: To start meditating—a very beneficial habit—find a quiet place where you won't be disturbed. Sit comfortably—in a chair or on a cushion—with your back straight but relaxed. Concentrate on your breath—the anchor of your practice—feeling how the air enters and leaves. Don't get frustrated if your mind wanders—it's completely normal at 1st—; simply gently redirect your attention to your breath each time. Start with short sessions, 5, or 10 minutes, and gradually increase the duration—when you feel more comfortable—until you reach 20 or 30 minutes a day. The key is consistency—even 3 days a week make a difference—not perfection; each session is an opportunity to practice mindfulness.

text_es: Preparing for a job interview, a crucial step in the job search, involves several important phases to maximize your chances of success. First, it is economical to thoroughly research the company and the position, understanding its mission and values, to tailor your answers. Next, review your resume and cover letter, memorizing dates and achievements, and be ready to justify every fact. It is also essential to anticipate possible questions, both common and challenging ones, and practice your answers out loud; a mock interview with a friend can be a bonus. It is important to plan intelligent questions for the interviewer, demonstrating interest and proactivity, at the end of the interview. Finally, appropriate and professional attire, and arriving 10 to 15 minutes early, are details that make a difference and show your control over the situation.
text_tgt_raw: Preparar-se para uma entrevista de emprego, um passo crucial na busca por uma vaga, envolve várias fases importantes para maximizar suas chances de sucesso. Primeiramente, é econômico pesquisar a fundo a empresa e o cargo, conhecendo sua missão e valores, para adaptar suas respostas. Em seguida, revise seu currículo e a carta de apresentação, memorizando datas e conquistas, e esteja pronto para justificar cada fato. Também é fundamental antecipar possíveis perguntas, tanto as mais comuns quanto as mais desafiadoras, e praticar suas respostas em voz alta; uma simulação com um amigo pode ser um bônus. É importante planejar perguntas inteligentes para o entrevistador, demonstrando interesse e proatividade, ao final da entrevista. Por fim, uma vestimenta adequada e profissional, e chegar com 10 a 15 minutos de antecedência, são detalhes que fazem a diferença e mostram seu controle sobre a situação.
base_en: Preparing for a job interview—a crucial step in the job search—involves several key phases to maximize the chances of success. 1st, it's essential to thoroughly research the company and the position—knowing its mission, values, and products—to tailor your answers. Then, you need to review your resume—memorizing dates and achievements—and cover letter, being prepared to justify each point. You should also anticipate possible questions—both typical and more challenging ones—and practice your answers out loud—preferably in front of a mirror or with a friend. It's important to prepare intelligent questions for the interviewer—demonstrating interest and proactivity—at the end of the interview. Finally, appropriate attire—professional and neat—and arriving on time—about 10 or 15 minutes early—are details that make a big difference.

text_es: Yesterday, I spent three hours preparing for a job interview—the one I had been looking forward to so much—for a software development position. The first thing I did was thoroughly research the company, its mission, and its values, as well as the profile of the position I was applying for, making sure to understand every detail. Next, I reviewed my resume—point by point—and my relevant experiences, thinking of concrete facts to illustrate my skills. I also practiced my answers to common questions, such as "Why do you want this position?", in front of the mirror, aiming for clear and confident articulation. Finally, I prepared some questions to ask them—something concise and essential to show interest—and chose appropriate attire—formal, but comfortable—for the big day. I hope everything goes well!
text_tgt_raw: Ontem, dediquei três horas a me preparar para uma entrevista de emprego—aquela que eu tanto esperava—para uma vaga de desenvolvimento de software. A primeira coisa que fiz foi pesquisar a fundo a empresa, sua missão e seus valores, além do perfil da posição que eu estava pleiteando, garantindo entender cada detalhe. Em seguida, revisei meu currículo—ponto a ponto—e minhas experiências relevantes, pensando em fatos concretos para ilustrar minhas habilidades. Também pratiquei minhas respostas para perguntas comuns, como "Por que você quer esta posição?", em frente ao espelho, buscando uma articulação clara e confiante. Para finalizar, preparei algumas perguntas para fazer a eles—algo econômico e essencial para mostrar interesse—e escolhi a roupa apropriada—formal, mas cômoda—para o grande dia. Espero que dê tudo certo!
base_en: Yesterday I spent 3 hours preparing for a job interview—the one I've been waiting for—for a software development position. The 1st thing I did was thoroughly research the company—its mission and values—and the profile of the position I was applying for, making sure to understand every detail. Afterward, I reviewed my own resume—point by point—and my relevant experiences, thinking of concrete examples I could use to illustrate my skills. I also practiced my answers to common questions—like "Why do you want this position?"—in front of the mirror, aiming for clear and confident articulation. Finally, I prepared some questions to ask them—essential for showing interest—and chose the appropriate clothing—formal, but comfortable—for the big day. Fingers crossed for success.

text_es: To prepare for a job interview, a crucial step in your career, it's essential to thoroughly research the company, its culture, and values, as well as the desired position and its main responsibilities. Review your resume, identifying your strengths, and think of concrete examples, using STAR situations, that demonstrate your relevant skills and experience. Prepare answers to common questions, such as those about your weaknesses, and formulate two or three intelligent questions for the interviewer, which shows genuine interest. Arrive 10 to 15 minutes early, dress professionally, maintaining a positive and confident attitude throughout the process. Remember, even if you take the bus to get there, the important thing is to be punctual and show that you are a professional who is economical in your answers but rich in content. It's a fact that preparation is the key to success. If you need to check any last-minute files on your phone, do so before entering.
text_tgt_raw: Para se preparar para uma entrevista de emprego, um passo crucial na sua carreira, é fundamental pesquisar a fundo a empresa, sua cultura e valores, além da posição almejada e suas responsabilidades principais.
