A rega é fundamental, adaptando-se à época do ano, ao tipo de cultura e às necessidades hídricas específicas de cada planta. É vital controlar pragas e doenças de forma orgânica, usando métodos preventivos, armadilhas ou remédios naturais. Poda, adubação e rotação de culturas são práticas essenciais para manter a fertilidade do solo, otimizar a produção e garantir a saúde a longo prazo das plantas. Um fato interessante é que um jardim urbano se torna um fenômeno de aprendizado e relaxamento, oferecendo benefícios nutricionais e ambientais. Adoro colher meu próprio abacaxi e preparar um suco refrescante, ou desfrutar de um café da manhã com produtos da minha horta. Além de tudo isso, a atividade é um ótimo esporte para o corpo e a mente, e evita ter que pegar o ônibus para ir ao açougue ou ao supermercado.
base_en: Caring for an urban garden implies dedication, knowledge, and daily observation, allowing for the cultivation of fresh, organic, and healthy foods. It requires selecting the appropriate location—sunny, sheltered, and with good drainage—and preparing the substrate, which must be rich in nutrients, aerated, and well-structured. The choice of plants is key, prioritizing species adapted to the local climate, with growth cycles according to the available space, such as lettuces, radishes, and spinach, or aromatic herbs like basil, mint, and parsley. Watering is fundamental, adapting to the time of year, type of crop, and specific water needs of each plant. It's vital to control pests and diseases organically, using preventive methods, traps, or natural remedies. Pruning, fertilizing, and crop rotation are essential practices to maintain soil fertility, optimize production, and ensure the long-term health of the plants. An urban garden is a space for learning, relaxation, and connection with nature, offering both nutritional and environmental benefits.

text_es: Caring for an urban garden has been a transformative experience, a true window into patience, effort, and reward. I remember the first time I sowed small tomato, lettuce, and bell pepper seeds; I didn't know what to expect, but the excitement was immense. Every morning, the first thing I do is check my plants, observe if new leaves, flowers, or fruits have appeared, or if they need watering, nutrients, or a little sun. It's a fascinating phenomenon to see how a strong, healthy, and productive plant emerges from a tiny germ, providing me with fresh, organic, and delicious ingredients for my kitchen. Sometimes there are challenges – pests, diseases, or adverse weather conditions – but learning to identify, treat, and prevent them is part of the process. In the end, the satisfaction of harvesting my own eggplants, zucchini, and herbs is indescribable, a joy that connects me with nature, with the earth, and with the cycle of life, and one that I recommend to everyone. Who knows, maybe one day I can even take a bus to visit a nursery and find new species for my garden. It's a fact that dedication brings many bonuses, and even if I need to plan for pest management, the result is worth it.
text_tgt_raw: Cuidar de um jardim urbano tem sido uma experiência transformadora, uma verdadeira janela para a paciência, o esforço e a recompensa. Lembro-me da primeira vez que semeei pequenas sementes de tomate, alface e pimentão; eu não sabia o que esperar, mas a emoção era imensa. Todo dia de manhã, a primeira coisa que faço é verificar minhas plantas, observar se novas folhas, flores ou frutos surgiram, ou se precisam de rega, nutrientes ou um pouco de sol. É um fenômeno fascinante ver como uma planta forte, saudável e produtiva emerge de um pequeno germe, me proporcionando ingredientes frescos, orgânicos e deliciosos para a minha cozinha. Às vezes, há desafios – pragas, doenças ou condições climáticas adversas – mas aprender a identificá-los, tratá-los e preveni-los faz parte do processo. No final, a satisfação de colher minhas próprias berinjelas, abobrinhas e ervas é indescritível, uma alegria que me conecta com a natureza, com a terra e com o ciclo da vida, e que eu recomendo a todos. Quem sabe, talvez um dia eu possa até usar um ônibus para visitar um viveiro e encontrar novas espécies para o meu jardim. É um fato que a dedicação traz muitos bônus, e mesmo que eu precise planejar o manejo de pragas, o resultado vale a pena.
base_en: Caring for an urban garden has been a transformative experience for me, a window into patience, effort, and reward. I remember the 1st time I sowed tiny tomato, lettuce, and pepper seeds; I didn't know what to expect, but the excitement was immense. Every morning, the 1st thing I do is check my plants, observe if new leaves, flowers, or fruits have sprouted, or if they need watering, nutrients, or a little sun. It's fascinating to see how a strong, healthy, and productive plant emerges from a small germ, providing me with fresh, organic, and delicious ingredients for my kitchen. Sometimes there are challenges—pests, diseases, or adverse weather conditions—but learning to identify, treat, and prevent them is part of the process. In the end, the satisfaction of harvesting my own eggplants, zucchini, and herbs is indescribable, a joy that connects me with nature, with the earth, and with the cycle of life, and that I recommend to everyone.

text_es: To successfully cultivate an urban garden, it's essential to start with good planning, choosing the ideal space and the species to be grown. Make sure the location, whether a balcony, terrace, or patio, receives at least 6 hours of direct sunlight per day. Opt for plants suitable for your climate, such as lettuce, tomatoes, and aromatic herbs, which are hardy and easy to manage. Soil preparation is a crucial factor: use a nutrient-rich mixture that drains well and is of good quality. Watering is another important pillar; do it regularly, avoiding waterlogging or excessive drying out of the soil. Observe your plants daily to detect pests, diseases, or nutritional deficiencies in time, such as yellowing leaves, spots, or the presence of insects. With patience, dedication, and constant monitoring, you will see your crops grow healthy, strong, and productive, providing economical and fresh food. If you need fertilizer, you can even ask your breakfast waiter to save the coffee grounds.
text_tgt_raw: Para cultivar um jardim urbano com sucesso, é fundamental iniciar com um bom planejamento, escolhendo o espaço ideal e as espécies a serem cultivadas. Certifique-se de que o local, seja uma varanda, terraço ou pátio, receba pelo menos 6 horas de luz solar direta por dia. Opte por plantas adequadas ao seu clima, como alfaces, tomates e ervas aromáticas, que são resistentes e fáceis de gerenciar. A preparação do solo é um fato crucial: utilize uma mistura rica em nutrientes, que drene bem e seja de boa qualidade. A rega é outro pilar importante; faça-a regularmente, evitando o encharcamento ou o ressecamento excessivo do solo. Observe suas plantas diariamente para detectar pragas, doenças ou deficiências nutricionais a tempo, como folhas amareladas, manchas ou a presença de insetos. Com paciência, dedicação e monitoramento constante, você verá suas colheitas crescerem saudáveis, fortes e produtivas, proporcionando um alimento econômico e fresco. Se precisar de um adubo, pode até pedir para o garçom do seu café da manhã guardar as borras de café.
base_en: To successfully care for an urban garden, it's crucial to start with planning, choosing the space, and determining the species to cultivate. Make sure the location receives at least 6 hours of direct sunlight per day, whether it's a balcony, a terrace, or a patio. Select plants suitable for your climate, such as lettuces, tomatoes, and aromatic herbs, which are hardy and easy to maintain. Soil preparation is fundamental; use a nutrient-rich mixture that drains well and is of good quality. Watering is another important pillar: do it regularly, avoiding waterlogging or extreme dryness of the soil. Observe your plants daily to detect pests, diseases, or nutritional deficiencies in time, such as yellow leaves, spots, or the presence of insects. With patience, dedication, and constant monitoring, you'll see your crops grow healthy, strong, and productive.

text_es: Planning a train trip is an excellent choice for those seeking comfort, efficiency, and scenic landscapes. First, it is essential to define the destination, dates, and duration of the trip, considering whether it's a weekend, an extended vacation, or a business trip. Next, research the available routes, the types of trains – regional, high-speed, or overnight – and the railway companies operating in the desired area. Buying tickets in advance usually guarantees more economical prices and the chance to choose specific seats or classes. It's always good to plan what to bring, such as documents, and perhaps a cell phone for entertainment. During the journey, the traveler can take the opportunity to read, converse, or simply admire the beauty of the architecture and nature. Finally, having a transportation plan upon arrival – whether it's a taxi, bus, or subway – ensures a smooth and stress-free transition.
text_tgt_raw: Planejar uma viagem de trem é uma escolha excelente para quem busca conforto, eficiência e paisagens cênicas. Primeiramente, é fundamental definir o destino, as datas e a duração da viagem, pensando se é um fim de semana, férias prolongadas ou uma viagem de negócios. Em seguida, pesquise as rotas disponíveis, os tipos de trem – regional, de alta velocidade ou noturno – e as companhias ferroviárias que operam na área desejada. Comprar passagens com antecedência geralmente garante preços mais econômicos e a chance de escolher assentos ou classes específicas. É sempre bom planejar o que levar, como documentos, e talvez um celular para entretenimento. Durante a jornada, o viajante pode aproveitar para ler, conversar ou apenas admirar a beleza da arquitetura e da natureza. Por fim, ter um plano de transporte ao chegar – seja táxi, ônibus ou metrô – garante uma transição tranquila e sem estresse.
base_en: Planning a train trip is an excellent option for those seeking comfort, efficiency, and picturesque landscapes. To begin, it's crucial to choose the destination, dates, and duration of the trip, considering whether it's a weekend getaway, a long vacation, or a business trip. Next, you should research available routes, types of trains—regional, high-speed, or overnight—and the railway companies operating in the desired area. Buying tickets in advance usually offers better prices, flexibility, and the opportunity to select specific seats, cars, or classes. It's advisable to pack intelligently, bringing essentials, identification documents, and some entertainment like books, music, or podcasts. During the journey, you can enjoy reading, converse with other travelers, or simply admire the scenery, architecture, and nature. Finally, having a transportation plan upon arrival—taxi, bus, or subway—will ensure a smooth and stress-free transition.

text_es: I remember the first time I tried to plan a train trip through Europe; it was a true odyssey of schedules, connections, and prices. I started by researching routes online, comparing destinations like Paris, Berlin, and Rome, and then trying to combine high-speed, regional, and overnight trains. The most complicated part was coordinating dates, departure locations, and arrivals so as not to miss any important connections. I spent hours on the Renfe, Deutsche Bahn, and SNCF websites, checking tickets, seats, and luggage – a task that required patience and attention. To make the trip even more economical, I needed to plan carefully and even consulted some facts on travel blogs. Finally, with everything booked – hotels, tickets, and excursions – I felt a great satisfaction, ready to enjoy the landscapes and culture. I learned that the key is organization, and perhaps a good map on my cell phone to avoid surprises.
text_tgt_raw: Lembro-me da primeira vez que tentei planejar uma viagem de trem pela Europa; foi uma verdadeira odisseia de horários, conexões e preços. Comecei pesquisando rotas online, comparando destinos como Paris, Berlim e Roma, e então tentando combinar trens de alta velocidade, regionais e noturnos. O mais complicado era coordenar as datas, locais de partida e chegadas para não perder nenhuma conexão importante. Passei horas nos sites da Renfe, Deutsche Bahn e SNCF, verificando bilhetes, assentos e bagagem – uma tarefa que exigiu paciência e atenção. Para deixar a viagem ainda mais econômica, precisei fazer um planejamento cuidadoso e até consultava alguns fatos em blogs de viagem. Finalmente, com tudo reservado – hotéis, passagens e excursões –, senti uma grande satisfação, pronto para aproveitar as paisagens e a cultura. Aprendi que a chave é organização, e talvez um bom mapa no meu celular para evitar surpresas.
base_en: I remember the 1st time I tried to plan a train trip through Europe, it was quite an odyssey of schedules, connections, and prices. I started by searching for routes online, comparing destinations like Paris, Berlin, and Rome, and then trying to match high-speed, regional, and night trains. The most complicated thing was coordinating the dates, departure locations, and arrivals, so I wouldn't miss any important connections. I spent hours on the Renfe, Deutsche Bahn, and SNCF websites, checking tickets, seats, and luggage—a task that required patience, attention, and some luck. Finally, with everything booked—hotels, tickets, and excursions—I felt great satisfaction, ready to enjoy the landscapes, food, and culture. I learned that the key is organization, foresight, and a good map to avoid surprises.

text_es: To plan a train trip, the first step is to research routes, schedules, and fares in advance, whether on official company websites, traveler forums, or travel agencies. Consider your priorities: comfort, speed, or a more economical price, as there are regional, high-speed, and overnight trains. Secure your tickets in advance, especially if you plan to travel during peak season, holidays, or weekends, to ensure the best seats. Pack your luggage efficiently, bringing only the essentials, important documents, and something to entertain yourself, like a book or a cell phone, to avoid carrying unnecessary weight. On the day of travel, arrive at the station with plenty of time to find your platform, check the information, and board without stress. On board, enjoy the scenic landscape, read, or rest, taking advantage of the benefits of this mode of transportation, which is, in fact, comfortable and ecological.
text_tgt_raw: Para planejar uma viagem de trem, o primeiro passo é pesquisar rotas, horários e tarifas com antecedência, seja nos sites oficiais das companhias, em fóruns de viajantes ou agências de viagem. Pense nas suas prioridades: conforto, velocidade ou um preço mais econômico, pois existem trens regionais, de alta velocidade e noturnos. Garanta seus bilhetes com antecedência, especialmente se for viajar na alta temporada, feriados ou fins de semana, para assegurar os melhores assentos. Prepare sua bagagem de forma eficiente, levando apenas o essencial, documentos importantes e algo para se entreter, como um livro ou um celular, para não carregar peso desnecessário. No dia da viagem, chegue à estação com tempo de sobra para localizar sua plataforma, verificar as informações e embarcar sem estresse. A bordo, aproveite a paisagem cênica, leia ou descanse, desfrutando dos benefícios desse meio de transporte que é, de fato, confortável e ecológico.
base_en: To plan a train trip, 1st, research routes, schedules, and fares in advance, visiting official company websites, traveler forums, or travel agencies. Consider your priorities: comfort, speed, or price, as there are regional, high-speed, and night trains. Book your tickets in advance, especially if you're traveling during high season, holidays, or weekends, to secure the best seats and fares. Pack your luggage efficiently, bringing essentials, necessary documentation, and entertainment, so you don't carry unnecessary weight. On the day of travel, arrive at the station with enough time to locate your platform, check the information, and board without rushing or stress. On board, enjoy the scenery, reading, or resting, taking advantage of the benefits of this comfortable, ecological, and scenic mode of transportation.

text_es: Making bread at home is a rewarding, simple, and economical experience that allows us to enjoy a staple food with unparalleled flavor, aroma, and texture. To start, you only need fundamental ingredients: flour, water, and yeast or sourdough starter. The basic process involves mixing, kneading, and letting the dough rise 2 or 3 times before baking. There are various techniques and recipes, from rustic breads with a crispy crust, airy crumb, and complex aroma, to softer breads for sandwiches or breakfast toast. You can add seeds, spices, or nuts to customize the bread, giving it a unique and delicious touch. Mastering the baking is fundamental, paying attention to the time, temperature, and humidity in the oven to avoid raw, dry, or burnt bread. It is a fact that this activity, in addition to an excellent culinary result, offers a moment of relaxation, creativity, and learning. It is a sport for kitchen lovers, a true phenomenon of flavor that disconnects you from routine, more pleasant than taking a crowded bus or having to manage work files.
text_tgt_raw: Fazer pão em casa é uma experiência gratificante, simples e econômica, que nos permite desfrutar de um alimento básico com sabor, aroma e textura inigualáveis. Para começar, você só precisa de ingredientes fundamentais: farinha, água e fermento ou massa madre. O processo básico envolve misturar, sovar e deixar a massa crescer 2 ou 3 vezes antes de assar. Existem diversas técnicas e receitas, desde pães rústicos com crosta crocante, miolo aerado e aroma complexo, até pães mais macios para sanduíches ou torradas no café da manhã. Você pode adicionar sementes, especiarias ou nozes para personalizar o pão, dando um toque único e delicioso. Dominar o cozimento é fundamental, prestando atenção ao tempo, temperatura e umidade no forno para evitar pão cru, seco ou queimado. É um fato que essa atividade, além de um excelente resultado culinário, oferece um momento de relaxamento, criatividade e aprendizado. É um esporte para os amantes da cozinha, um verdadeiro fenômeno de sabor que te desconecta da rotina, mais agradável que pegar um ônibus lotado ou ter que gerenciar arquivos de trabalho.
base_en: Making bread at home is a rewarding, simple, and economical experience that allows you to enjoy a basic food with an unbeatable flavor, aroma, and texture. To start, you only need fundamental ingredients: flour, water, and yeast or sourdough. The basic process involves mixing, kneading, and letting the dough rise 2 or 3 times before baking it. There are diverse techniques and recipes, from rustic breads with a crispy crust, airy crumb, and complex aroma to softer breads for sandwiches or toast. You can add seeds, spices, or nuts to customize the bread, giving it a unique and delicious touch. Mastering the baking is key, paying attention to the time, temperature, and humidity in the oven to avoid raw, dry, or burned bread. It's an activity that, in addition to an excellent culinary result, offers a moment of relaxation, creativity, and learning.

text_es: I fondly remember the first time I decided to bake bread at home, a whim that brought me joy, nervousness, and great satisfaction. I started with an economical recipe, using flour, water, and yeast, basic but crucial elements. Kneading the dough was an arduous task; my arms and hands ached, but the idea of fresh bread motivated me. As it fermented, the aroma of yeast and olive oil filled the kitchen, creating a cozy atmosphere. Finally, as I took the bread out of the oven, its golden crust and homemade smell transported me. I cut a slice, spread butter, and savored every bite—an unforgettable and delicious fact. Since that day, baking bread has become a passion, a ritual I share with my team and friends, perhaps accompanied by a cup of coffee or pineapple juice. Even planning what kind of bread to make has become a sport.
text_tgt_raw: Lembro-me com carinho da primeira vez que decidi assar pão em casa, um capricho que me trouxe alegria, nervosismo e grande satisfação. Comecei com uma receita econômica, usando farinha, água e fermento, elementos básicos mas cruciais. Amassar a massa foi uma tarefa árdua; meus braços e mãos doíam, mas a ideia de pão fresco me motivava. Enquanto fermentava, o aroma de fermento e azeite enchia a cozinha, criando uma atmosfera acolhedora. Finalmente, ao tirar o pão do forno, sua crosta dourada e cheiro caseiro me transportaram. Cortei uma fatia, passei manteiga e saboreei cada mordida – um fato inesquecível e delicioso. Desde aquele dia, assar pão virou uma paixão, um ritual que compartilho com minha equipe e amigos, talvez acompanhado de uma xícara de café ou suco de abacaxi. Até mesmo planejar qual tipo de pão fazer se tornou um esporte.
base_en: I fondly remember the 1st time I decided to bake bread at home, a culinary whim that brought me joy, nervousness, and great satisfaction. I started with a simple recipe, using flour, water, and yeast, basic but crucial elements. Kneading the dough was an arduous task; my arms, back, and hands ached, but the idea of freshly baked bread motivated me. While it fermented, the aroma of yeast, oil, and patience filled the kitchen, creating a cozy atmosphere. Finally, upon taking the bread out of the oven, its golden crust, crispy texture, and homey smell transported me. I cut a slice, spread it with butter, jam, or honey, and enjoyed every bite—an unforgettable, comforting, and delicious experience. Since that day, baking has become a passion, a ritual I share with my family and friends.

text_es: When venturing into the art of making homemade bread, patience and precision are your greatest allies, an undeniable fact. It is essential to acquire quality ingredients, such as good flour, water, and yeast, to ensure an excellent and economical result. Start with simpler recipes, like a basic white bread or a focaccia, before venturing into more complex preparations. Don't be discouraged if the first attempts aren't perfect; the process of kneading, fermenting, and baking requires time and practice. Tools like a good thermometer and a scale are indispensable for easily measuring and managing the dough. Observe the dough carefully—its elasticity, texture, and growth—adjusting the hydration if necessary to avoid a dry or sticky consistency. With perseverance and attention to detail, you will soon enjoy fresh, aromatic, and delicious breads, perhaps even with juice or a good breakfast to accompany them.
text_tgt_raw: Ao se aventurar na arte de fazer pão caseiro, paciência e precisão são seus maiores aliados, um fato inegável. É fundamental adquirir ingredientes de qualidade, como uma boa farinha, água e fermento, para garantir um resultado excelente e econômico. Comece com receitas mais simples, como um pão branco básico ou uma focaccia, antes de se aventurar em preparações mais complexas. Não se desanime se as primeiras tentativas não forem perfeitas; o processo de sovar, fermentar e assar exige tempo e prática. Ferramentas como um bom termômetro e uma balança são indispensáveis para medir e gerenciar a massa com facilidade. Observe a massa com atenção — sua elasticidade, textura e crescimento —, ajustando a hidratação se necessário para evitar uma consistência seca ou pegajosa. Com perseverança e atenção aos detalhes, você logo desfrutará de pães frescos, aromáticos e deliciosos, talvez até mesmo com um suco ou um bom café da manhã para acompanhar.
base_en: When you start making homemade bread, patience, precision, and practice are your best allies. It's essential to acquire good ingredients like quality flour, water, and yeast to ensure an optimal result. Start with simple recipes—white bread, whole wheat bread, or a basic focaccia—before venturing into more complex preparations. Don't get discouraged if the 1st or 2nd attempts aren't perfect; kneading, fermentation, and baking require skill, intuition, and time. A good thermometer, a scale, and a dough scraper will be indispensable tools for measuring, mixing, and handling with ease. Observe the dough carefully—its elasticity, its texture, its growth—and adjust the hydration if necessary to avoid a dry, sticky, or hard consistency. With perseverance, passion, and attention to detail, you'll soon enjoy fresh, aromatic, and delicious loaves.

text_es: Adopting a dog is an act of love, responsibility, and commitment, a fact that transforms everyone's life. This process involves offering a home to an animal that needs affection, security, and attention. Before making this decision, it is crucial to consider the available time, economic resources, and physical space for the new family member. There are several options to find your ideal companion: shelters, NGOs, and associations specializing in animal rescue. By adopting, you not only save a life but also contribute to reducing the number of abandoned, mistreated, or homeless animals. It is important to know about the dog's temperament, age, and specific needs to ensure good adaptation and a lasting, happy, and harmonious coexistence. Remember that adoption is an opportunity to give a second life to a living being who is loyal, faithful, and grateful, and perhaps even to take them by bus or train to a new home.
text_tgt_raw: Adotar um cachorro é um ato de amor, responsabilidade e comprometimento, um fato que transforma a vida de todos. Este processo envolve oferecer um lar a um animal que precisa de carinho, segurança e atenção. Antes de tomar essa decisão, é crucial considerar o tempo disponível, os recursos econômicos e o espaço físico para o novo membro da família. Existem diversas opções para encontrar seu companheiro ideal: abrigos, ONGs e associações especializadas em resgate de animais. Ao adotar, você não apenas salva uma vida, mas também contribui para reduzir o número de animais abandonados, maltratados ou sem teto. É importante saber sobre o temperamento do cachorro, sua idade e suas necessidades específicas para garantir uma boa adaptação e uma convivência duradoura, feliz e harmoniosa. Lembre-se que a adoção é uma oportunidade de dar uma segunda vida a um ser vivo, leal, fiel e grato, e talvez até de levá-lo de ônibus ou trem para um novo lar.
base_en: Adopting a dog is an act of love, responsibility, and commitment. This process involves offering a home to an animal that needs affection, security, and attention. Before making this decision, it's crucial to consider the available time, economic resources, and physical space for the new family member. There are diverse options to find your ideal companion: shelters, rescues, and associations specializing in animal rescue. By adopting, you not only save a life, but you also contribute to reducing the number of abandoned, mistreated, or homeless animals. It's important to learn about the dog's character, age, and specific needs to ensure a good adaptation and a lasting, happy, and harmonious coexistence. Remember that adoption is an opportunity to give a 2nd life to a living being—faithful, loyal, and grateful.

text_es: I remember the day I decided to adopt a dog as if it were yesterday. I was looking for a loyal, affectionate, and playful companion, and after visiting several shelters, I found Luna, a 3-month-old mixed-breed puppy, at a local kennel. Her big, sad, and curious eyes instantly moved me, and her timidly wagging tail told me she was the one. The first few days were chaotic: I had to teach her where to relieve herself, not to chew furniture, and to socialize with other dogs, cats, and people. Today, after two years, she is the joy of the house, an inexhaustible source of happiness, laughter, and adventures that I wouldn't trade for anything. Her presence transformed my life, bringing me unconditional love, constant companionship, and a new perspective. It's a fact that a small decision can bring so much joy and renewed purpose to daily life, more than an unexpected bonus. I go out with her for walks and ice cream, and it's always a lot of fun. When I travel, even by bus, I miss her.
text_tgt_raw: Lembro-me do dia em que decidi adotar um cachorro como se fosse ontem. Eu buscava um companheiro leal, carinhoso e brincalhão, e depois de visitar vários abrigos, encontrei a Luna, uma filhote vira-lata de 3 meses, em um canil local. Seus olhos grandes, tristes e curiosos me emocionaram instantaneamente, e seu rabo abanando timidamente me disse que ela era a escolhida. Os primeiros dias foram caóticos: tive que ensiná-la onde fazer as necessidades, a não mastigar móveis e a socializar com outros cachorros, gatos e pessoas. Hoje, depois de dois anos, ela é a alegria da casa, uma fonte inesgotável de felicidade, risadas e aventuras que eu não trocaria por nada. Sua presença transformou minha vida, trazendo-me amor incondicional, companhia constante e uma nova perspectiva. É um fato que uma pequena decisão pode trazer tanta alegria e um propósito renovado ao dia a dia, mais do que um bônus inesperado. Saio com ela para passear e tomar um sorvete, e é sempre muito divertido. Quando viajo, mesmo que de ônibus, sinto falta dela.
base_en: I remember the day I decided to adopt a dog as if it were yesterday. I was looking for a loyal, affectionate, and playful companion, and after visiting several shelters, I found Luna, a 3-month-old mixed-breed puppy, at a local pound. Her big, sad, and curious eyes instantly moved me, and her timidly wagging tail told me she was the one. The 1st days were chaotic: I had to teach her where to relieve herself, not to chew on furniture, and to socialize with other dogs, cats, and people. Now, after 2 years, she's the joy of the house, an inexhaustible source of happiness, laughter, and adventures that I wouldn't trade for anything. Her presence has transformed my life, bringing me unconditional love, constant companionship, and a new perspective on life. It's incredible how a small decision can bring so much joy, warmth, and renewed purpose to your daily life.

text_es: When adopting a dog, it's essential to consider the animal's breed, size, and temperament. Before bringing it home, research its feeding, exercise, and socialization needs for good planning. Prepare your home by creating a safe and comfortable space with toys, and don't forget to plan daily walks, whether by bus or on foot. It's crucial to teach basic coexistence rules, such as sit, stay, and come, using positive reinforcement, patience, and consistency, never using your cell phone as a distraction during training. Remember that a dog is a long-term responsibility: it requires time, money, and an academic commitment to its well-being. Find a trusted veterinarian for regular check-ups, vaccinations, and deworming, ensuring your new friend's health. Enjoy this new phase full of affection, joy, and many adventures!
text_tgt_raw: Ao adotar um cachorro, é fundamental considerar a raça, o tamanho e o temperamento do animal. Antes de trazê-lo para casa, pesquise suas necessidades de alimentação, exercícios e socialização para um bom planejamento. Prepare sua casa criando um espaço seguro e cômodo com brinquedos, e não esqueça de planejar os passeios diários, seja de ônibus ou a pé. É crucial ensinar regras básicas de convivência, como sentar, ficar e vir, utilizando reforço positivo, paciência e consistência, sem nunca usar o celular como distração durante o treinamento. Lembre-se de que um cachorro é uma responsabilidade de longo prazo: exige tempo, dinheiro e um compromisso acadêmico com seu bem-estar. Encontre um veterinário de confiança para check-ups regulares, vacinações e desvermifugação, garantindo a saúde do seu novo amigo. Desfrute dessa nova fase repleta de afeto, alegria e muitas aventuras!
base_en: When adopting a dog, consider its breed, size, and temperament. Before bringing it home, research its feeding, exercise, and socialization needs. Prepare your home by creating a safe, comfortable space with toys. It's crucial to teach it basic coexistence rules like sitting, staying, and coming, using positive reinforcement, patience, and consistency. Be aware that a dog is a long-term responsibility: it requires time, money, and commitment. Find a trusted veterinarian and perform regular check-ups, vaccinations, and deworming to ensure its health and well-being. Enjoy this new stage full of affection, joy, and adventures.

text_es: Assembling a shelf, whether made of wood, metal, or plastic, requires several crucial steps to ensure its stability, functionality, and aesthetics. First, it's essential to gather the right tools, such as a screwdriver, a hammer, and a level, and organize all the parts: the shelves, the supports, and the screws. Space preparation is fundamental; make sure the surface is flat, clean, and suitable for the weight the shelf will support. The assembly process begins by precisely attaching the sides, shelves, and reinforcements, following the manufacturer's instructions to the letter to avoid errors, damage, or instability. After assembly, check that it is firm, level, and well-anchored to the wall, if necessary, to prevent tipping or accidents. For transporting larger pieces, a truck can be useful, and for details, good file management is important. Finally, you can start organizing your books, decorative objects, and files, distributing the weight evenly and making the most of the available storage space. This DIY project, with careful planning and precise execution, can significantly improve the organization and appearance of any room, office, or pantry.
text_tgt_raw: Montar uma estante, seja de madeira, metal ou plástico, exige vários passos cruciais para garantir sua estabilidade, funcionalidade e estética. Primeiramente, é essencial reunir as ferramentas certas, como uma chave de fenda, um martelo e um nível, e organizar todas as peças: as prateleiras, os suportes e os parafusos. A preparação do espaço é fundamental; certifique-se de que a superfície seja plana, limpa e adequada para o peso que a estante suportará. O processo de montagem começa fixando precisamente as laterais, prateleiras e reforços, seguindo as instruções do fabricante à risca para evitar erros, danos ou instabilidade. Após a montagem, verifique se está firme, nivelada e bem ancorada à parede, se necessário, para prevenir tombamento ou acidentes. Para o transporte de peças maiores, um caminhão pode ser útil, e para detalhes, um bom gerenciamento de arquivos é importante. Finalmente, você pode começar a organizar seus livros, objetos decorativos e arquivos, distribuindo o peso uniformemente e aproveitando ao máximo o espaço de armazenamento disponível. Este projeto “faça você mesmo”, com um planejamento cuidadoso e uma execução precisa, pode melhorar significativamente a organização e a aparência de qualquer cômodo, escritório ou despensa.
base_en: Assembling a shelving unit, whether made of wood, metal, or plastic, involves several key steps to ensure its stability, functionality, and aesthetics. Initially, it's crucial to gather the right tools, such as a screwdriver, a hammer, and a level, and organize all the parts: the boards, the brackets, and the screws. Space preparation is fundamental; make sure the surface is flat, clean, and suitable for the intended weight. The assembly process begins by precisely attaching the sides, shelves, and reinforcements, following the manufacturer's instructions to the letter to avoid errors, damage, or instability. Once assembled, verify that it's firm, level, and well-anchored to the wall if necessary to prevent tipping, falling, or accidents. Finally, you can start organizing your books, decorative objects, and files, distributing the weight evenly and making the most of the available storage space. This DIY project, with careful planning and execution, can significantly improve the organization and appearance of any room, office, or storage room.

text_es: On May first, in a moment of naive optimism, I decided to assemble a new bookshelf to organize my books and decorations. I started with enthusiasm, opening the box and taking out the panels, screws, and hardware, convinced it would be a simple, quick, and pleasant task. However, when I tried to follow the instructions, which looked like hieroglyphs, I realized the reality was quite different; the diagrams were confusing, tiny, and ambiguous. I spent two hours turning screws, hammering, and tightening, feeling a mix of frustration, exhaustion, and anger. In the end, with one panel inverted, three loose screws, and a wobbly shelf, the bookshelf stood—barely and poorly—demonstrating my ability to transform something supposedly economical and practical into a complex, laborious, and maddening phenomenon. Despite everything, it's there, fulfilling its function more or less stably, but with a rustic, imperfect, and personal touch that makes it unique.
text_tgt_raw: No dia primeiro de maio, em um momento de otimismo ingênuo, decidi montar uma estante nova para organizar meus livros e decorações. Comecei com entusiasmo, abrindo a caixa e retirando os painéis, parafusos e ferragens, convencido de que seria uma tarefa simples, rápida e prazerosa. Contudo, ao tentar seguir as instruções, que pareciam hieróglifos, percebi que a realidade era bem outra; os diagramas eram confusos, minúsculos e ambíguos. Passei duas horas girando parafusos, martelando e apertando, sentindo uma mistura de frustração, cansaço e raiva. No fim, com um painel invertido, três parafusos soltos e uma prateleira bamba, a estante se mantinha de pé — mal e porcamente — demonstrando minha habilidade de transformar algo supostamente econômico e prático em um fenômeno complexo, trabalhoso e enlouquecedor. Apesar de tudo, está ali, cumprindo sua função mais ou menos estável, mas com um toque rústico, imperfeito e pessoal que a torna única.
base_en: On May 1st, I decided, with great optimism, to assemble a new bookshelf to organize my books, magazines, and decorations. I started with enthusiasm, opening the box and taking out the panels, screws, and hardware, convinced that it would be a simple, quick, and gratifying task. However, upon following the instructions—which seemed like hieroglyphics—I realized that the reality was quite different; the diagrams were confusing, small, and ambiguous. I spent 2 hours trying to fit pieces, hammering, tightening, and loosening screws, feeling a mix of frustration, tiredness, and anger. Finally, with 1 panel upside down, 3 loose screws, and 1 wobbly board, the bookshelf stood—barely—upright, demonstrating my ability to turn something simple into something complex, laborious, and maddening. Despite everything, there it's, fulfilling its function more or less stably, though with a rustic, imperfect, and personal touch that makes it unique.

text_es: To successfully assemble a shelf, it's crucial to plan each step and organize your space well. First, check that all necessary screws and components are present, because, believe it or not, sometimes items are missing, which can be frustrating. Organize your workspace for good lighting and comfort, thus avoiding unnecessary interruptions. Follow the manufacturer's instructions carefully, step by step, without skipping any part. This ensures the stability and functionality of the furniture. If the shelf is large or heavy, don't hesitate to ask for help; an extra pair of hands is always welcome to prevent accidents or damage. Finally, make sure the shelf is level and securely fixed, ready for use, whether for your books or collections. Good planning saves time and effort.
text_tgt_raw: Para montar uma prateleira com sucesso, é crucial planejar cada etapa e organizar bem seu espaço. Primeiro, verifique se todos os parafusos e componentes necessários estão presentes, pois, acredite, às vezes faltam itens, o que pode ser um fato frustrante. Organize sua área de trabalho para ter uma boa iluminação e conforto, evitando assim interrupções desnecessárias. Siga as instruções do fabricante cuidadosamente, passo a passo, sem pular nenhuma parte. Isso garante a estabilidade e funcionalidade do móvel. Se a prateleira for grande ou pesada, não hesite em pedir ajuda; uma equipe extra de mãos é sempre bem-vinda para evitar acidentes ou danos. Por fim, certifique-se de que a prateleira esteja nivelada e bem fixa, pronta para o uso, seja para seus livros ou coleções. Um bom planejamento é econômico em termos de tempo e esforço.
base_en: To successfully assemble a shelf, plan each step well, prepare the tools, and read the instructions. Before starting, verify that you've all the necessary parts, screws, and hardware, because sometimes nuts, washers, or brackets are missing. Organize your workspace to have good light, comfort, and safety, which will make assembly easier for you. Follow the manufacturer's instructions 1st, 2nd, and 3rd, without skipping steps, to ensure stability and functionality. Make sure to properly secure each shelf, panel, and back, using the correct screwdriver. Ask someone for help if the shelf is large or heavy—it's better to work with an extra pair of hands—to avoid falls, damage, or injuries. Finally, check that the shelf is level, firm, and secure, ready to support your books, decorations, and objects.

text_es: To save for your vacation, start with clear planning, a thrifty budget, and measurable goals. First, review your current expenses—daily, weekly, and monthly—to identify where you can cut costs, such as eating out, breakfast, or impulse purchases. Open a specific savings account for this purpose, so the money remains separate, secure, and focused. Consider small habit changes that add up significantly, like bringing lunch to work, reducing non-essential subscriptions—the gym, magazines—or taking advantage of offers and discounts. Another tip is to use public transportation, like the bus, instead of the car, or even the train, if possible, as this generates good fuel savings. Establish a fixed weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly savings amount and try not to deviate, so it becomes a routine. Small, consistent contributions are much more effective than large, sporadic sums, as they create a solid and reliable foundation. Remember that every dollar counts, so be patient, consistent, and optimistic on the way to your dream vacation.
text_tgt_raw: Para economizar para as férias, comece com um planejamento claro, um orçamento econômico e metas mensuráveis. Primeiro, revise suas despesas atuais — diárias, semanais e mensais — para identificar onde você pode cortar gastos, como comer fora, o café da manhã ou compras por impulso. Abra uma conta poupança específica para essa finalidade, para que o dinheiro fique separado, seguro e focado. Considere pequenas mudanças de hábito que se somam significativamente, como levar almoço para o trabalho, reduzir assinaturas não essenciais — a academia, revistas — ou aproveitar ofertas e descontos. Outra dica é usar o transporte público, como o ônibus, em vez do carro, ou até mesmo o trem, se possível, pois isso gera uma boa economia de combustível. Estabeleça um valor fixo de economia semanal, quinzenal ou mensal e tente não desviar, para que se torne uma rotina. Pequenas contribuições consistentes são muito mais eficazes do que grandes somas esporádicas, pois criam uma base sólida e confiável. Lembre-se que cada real conta, então seja paciente, consistente e otimista no caminho para suas férias dos sonhos.
base_en: To save for vacation, start with a clear plan, a realistic budget, and measurable goals. 1st, review your current expenses—daily, weekly, and monthly—to identify areas where you can cut back, such as eating out, morning coffee, or impulse purchases. Open a specific savings account for this purpose, so the money will be separate, secure, and focused. Consider small habit changes that add up significantly, such as bringing lunch to work, reducing non-essential subscriptions—Netflix, the gym, magazines—or taking advantage of offers and discounts. Establish a fixed weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly savings amount and try not to deviate, so it becomes a routine, a habit, or a discipline. Small, consistent contributions are much more effective than large, sporadic sums, as they create a solid, reliable, and continuous foundation. Remember that every euro counts, so be patient, consistent, and optimistic on your way to your dream vacation.

text_es: Learning a new language is, in fact, an enriching experience that opens doors to other cultures, ideas, and opportunities. This process involves the acquisition of vocabulary, grammar, and phonetics, which has been proven to enhance cognitive skills, memory, and concentration. There are several strategies to achieve this goal, such as total immersion, structured classes, or self-taught learning through apps and movies. For those who travel, it is very economical to be able to communicate without needing a translator, whether to catch a bus or order an ice cream. Consistency, patience, and daily practice are essential to maintain motivation, overcome obstacles, and achieve the desired fluency. Many students choose to learn languages for work, travel, or personal reasons, seeking to enrich their lives with new perspectives and friendships. It is a path that requires effort, dedication, and curiosity, but it rewards with lasting benefits in the professional, personal, and cultural spheres, even allowing one to enjoy a good breakfast in another country or talk about sports with a native, all while using a cell phone for any questions.
text_tgt_raw: Aprender um novo idioma é, de fato, uma experiência enriquecedora que abre portas para outras culturas, ideias e oportunidades. Esse processo envolve a aquisição de vocabulário, gramática e fonética, o que comprovadamente aprimora habilidades cognitivas, memória e concentração. Existem várias estratégias para alcançar esse objetivo, como imersão total, aulas estruturadas ou o aprendizado autodidata por meio de aplicativos e filmes. Para quem viaja, é muito econômico poder se comunicar sem precisar de tradutor, seja para pegar um ônibus ou pedir um sorvete. Consistência, paciência e prática diária são essenciais para manter a motivação, superar obstáculos e atingir a fluência desejada. Muitos estudantes escolhem aprender idiomas por motivos de trabalho, viagens ou pessoais, buscando enriquecer suas vidas com novas perspectivas e amizades. É um caminho que exige esforço, dedicação e curiosidade, mas que recompensa com benefícios duradouros nas esferas profissional, pessoal e cultural, permitindo até mesmo desfrutar de um bom café da manhã em outro país ou conversar sobre esportes com um nativo, tudo usando o celular para eventuais dúvidas.
base_en: Learning a new language is an enriching experience that opens doors to other cultures, ideas, and opportunities. This process involves acquiring vocabulary, grammar, and phonetics, which improves cognitive abilities, memory, and concentration. There are various strategies to achieve this, such as total immersion, structured classes, or self-taught learning through apps, books, and movies. Consistency, patience, and daily practice are essential to maintain motivation, overcome obstacles, and achieve desired fluency. Many students choose to learn languages for work, travel, or personal reasons, seeking to enrich their lives with new perspectives, friendships, and experiences. It's a path that requires effort, dedication, and curiosity, but it rewards with lasting benefits in professional, personal, and cultural spheres.

text_es: I remember my first trip to Portugal, five years ago; it was an exciting, enriching, and a little scary experience, since my command of Portuguese was, shall we say, basic. At first, communication was a real challenge: ordering food, asking for directions, or even a simple "hello" turned into an odyssey of gestures, smiles, and dubious pronunciations. But, little by little, with each day, each conversation, and each new word I learned, I began to feel more at ease and, most importantly, to understand. My strategy was based on total immersion: I listened to the radio, watched television, and talked to everyone I met, whether they were shop assistants, waiters, or curious passersby. It was a slow, demanding, and sometimes frustrating process, but the reward of being able to converse fluently and understand the local culture, its customs, and its people, was worth the effort. Today, I can say that learning Portuguese not only opened doors to a new language for me, but also to a new way of seeing the world, a fact I consider very valuable. I didn't take a bus or train there, but my cell phone was a great ally.
text_tgt_raw: Lembro-me da minha primeira viagem a Portugal, cinco anos atrás; foi uma experiência empolgante, enriquecedora e um pouco assustadora, já que meu comando do português era, digamos, básico. No começo, a comunicação era um verdadeiro desafio: pedir comida, perguntar por direções ou até mesmo um simples "olá" virava uma odisseia de gestos, sorrisos e pronúncias duvidosas. Mas, pouco a pouco, com cada dia, cada conversa e cada palavra nova que aprendia, comecei a me sentir mais à vontade e, o mais importante, a compreender. Minha estratégia se baseava na imersão total: eu ouvia rádio, assistia televisão e conversava com cada pessoa que encontrava, fossem atendentes, garçons ou curiosos transeuntes. Era um processo lento, exigente e, às vezes, frustrante, mas a recompensa de poder conversar fluentemente e entender a cultura local, seus costumes e seu povo, valeu o esforço. Hoje, posso dizer que aprender português não só me abriu as portas para uma nova língua, mas também para uma nova forma de ver o mundo, um fato que considero muito valioso. Não peguei um ônibus ou trem por lá, mas meu celular foi um grande aliado.
base_en: I remember my 1st trip to Portugal 5 years ago; it was an exciting, enriching, and a little terrifying experience, since my command of Portuguese was, let's say, basic. At 1st, communication was a real challenge: ordering food, directions, or even a simple "hello" became an odyssey of gestures, smiles, and dubious pronunciations. But little by little, with each day, each conversation, and each new word learned, I began to feel more comfortable and, most importantly, to understand. My strategy was based on total immersion: I listened to the radio, watched television, and spoke with every person I met, whether they were clerks, waiters, or curious passersby. It was a slow, demanding, and, at times, frustrating process, but the reward of being able to converse fluently and understand the local culture, its customs, and its people, was worth the effort. Today, I can say that learning Portuguese not only opened the doors to a new language for me, but also to a new way of seeing the world.

text_es: To learn a new language, consistency is essential, so set realistic and measurable goals. Start with the basics – greetings, introductions, and numbers – and don't be afraid to make mistakes, as they are part of the process. Surround yourself with the language as much as possible: listen to music, watch movies or series with subtitles, and read books, articles, or even interesting facts on websites in the target language. Practice daily by talking with native speakers, repeating phrases, and writing short texts. This will strengthen your listening comprehension, speaking, and writing skills. Stay motivated by exploring the culture associated with the language – gastronomy, history, and sports, for example – which will enrich your learning in unexpected ways. Remember that patience, dedication, and fun are essential for effective and lasting progress. Good planning can prevent you from taking a bus to class and realizing you forgot your academic materials.
text_tgt_raw: Para aprender um novo idioma, a constância é fundamental, então estabeleça metas realistas e mensuráveis. Comece com o básico – saudações, apresentações e números – e não tenha medo de cometer erros, pois eles são parte do processo. Cerque-se do idioma o máximo possível: ouça músicas, assista a filmes ou séries com legendas e leia livros, artigos ou até mesmo fatos interessantes em sites na língua-alvo. Pratique diariamente conversando com falantes nativos, repetindo frases e escrevendo textos curtos. Isso fortalecerá sua compreensão auditiva, expressão oral e escrita. Mantenha-se motivado explorando a cultura associada ao idioma – gastronomia, história e esportes, por exemplo –, o que enriquecerá seu aprendizado de maneiras inesperadas. Lembre-se que paciência, dedicação e diversão são essenciais para um progresso eficaz e duradouro. Um bom planejamento pode evitar que você pegue um ônibus para a aula e perceba que esqueceu seu material acadêmico.
base_en: To learn a new language, consistency is key, so set realistic, tangible, and measurable goals. Start with the basics—greetings, introductions, and numbers—and don't be afraid to make mistakes, as they're part of the process. Surround yourself with the language as much as possible: listen to music, watch movies or series with subtitles, and read books, articles, or comics in the target language. Practice daily by speaking with native speakers, repeating phrases, and writing short texts. This will strengthen your listening comprehension, oral expression, and writing. Stay motivated by exploring the culture associated with the language—gastronomy, history, and traditions—which will enrich your learning in unexpected ways. Remember that patience, dedication, and fun are essential for effective and lasting progress.

text_es: Participating in a popular race is a phenomenon that attracts people of all levels and ages, democratizing access to sports. Generally organized by city halls, clubs, or associations, these events promote health, camaraderie, and often raise funds for social causes. Runners can choose from various distances, such as 5 km, 10 km, or half marathons, and registration is usually done online or at specialized stores. To prepare, it is essential to have a good training plan, taking care of hydration, nutrition, and rest. It is also crucial to study the course and hydration stations to avoid unforeseen events. Many runners arrive at the location by bus, and after the race, they celebrate with a juice or ice cream, enjoying the feeling of overcoming and camaraderie, facts that make the experience even more rewarding.
text_tgt_raw: Participar de uma corrida popular é um fenômeno que atrai pessoas de todos os níveis e idades, democratizando o acesso ao esporte. Geralmente organizados por prefeituras, clubes ou associações, esses eventos promovem a saúde, a convivência e, muitas vezes, arrecadam fundos para causas sociais. Os corredores podem escolher entre diversas distâncias, como 5 km, 10 km ou meias maratonas, e o registro costuma ser feito online ou em lojas especializadas. Para se preparar, é fundamental ter um bom planejamento de treino, cuidando da hidratação, nutrição e descanso. É crucial também estudar o percurso e as estações de hidratação para evitar imprevistos. Muitos corredores chegam ao local de ônibus, e após a prova, celebram com um suco ou sorvete, desfrutando da sensação de superação e da camaradagem, fatos que tornam a experiência ainda mais gratificante.
base_en: Running a popular race involves participating in a sporting event open to all audiences, regardless of their physical level, age, or previous experience. These events, often organized by city councils, clubs, or associations, aim to promote sports, coexistence, and, sometimes, raise funds for charitable causes. Participants usually choose among different distances, such as 5 km, 10 km, or half marathons, and can register online, in specialized stores, or on the day of the event. Preparation for these races requires discipline, a good training plan, and attention to hydration, nutrition, and rest. It's essential to review the course, know the aid stations, and warm up properly before the start to avoid injuries, cramps, or fatigue. Upon finishing, many runners experience great personal satisfaction, camaraderie with other participants, and the enjoyment of outdoor physical activity.

text_es: Last Sunday, I finally decided to participate in my first popular race in the city, something I had wanted to do for a long time to test my limits, my endurance, and my strength. I planned everything weeks in advance, doing my runs in parks and on streets, which helped me a lot to improve my pace. On the morning of the race, I felt a mix of nervousness and excitement, a little fear, especially seeing so many fans and participants gathered at the starting line. The atmosphere was incredible: music, encouragement, and a spirit of camaraderie that spread quickly. Along the course, people cheered on the runners with shouts, applause, and songs, which gave an extra push in moments of greater effort and physical and mental exhaustion. Upon crossing the finish line, the feeling of overcoming, pride, and joy was immense, a fact that I recommend to everyone looking for a personal challenge. It was such a memorable moment that I can't wait to plan the next race, maybe even a longer course, using my cell phone to record every kilometer.
text_tgt_raw: No último domingo, decidi finalmente participar da minha primeira corrida popular na cidade, algo que eu desejava há muito tempo para testar meus limites, minha resistência e minha força. Planejei tudo com semanas de antecedência, fazendo minhas corridas em parques e ruas, o que me ajudou bastante a melhorar meu ritmo. Na manhã da corrida, senti um misto de nervosismo e excitação, um pouco de medo, especialmente ao ver tantos torcedores e participantes reunidos na linha de partida. A atmosfera era incrível: música, incentivo e um espírito de camaradagem que se espalhou rapidamente. Durante o percurso, as pessoas animavam os corredores com gritos, aplausos e cantos, o que dava um empurrão extra nos momentos de maior esporte e exaustão física e mental. Ao cruzar a linha de chegada, a sensação de superação, orgulho e alegria era imensa, um fato que eu recomendo a todos que buscam um desafio pessoal. Foi um momento tão marcante que mal posso esperar para planejar a próxima corrida, quem sabe até um percurso mais longo, usando meu celular para registrar cada quilômetro.
base_en: Last Sunday I decided, finally, to run my 1st popular race in my city, something I had wanted to do for a long time to test my limits, my endurance, and my strength. I prepared several weeks in advance, going out jogging through parks, streets, and boardwalks, which helped me a lot to improve my pace. On the morning of the race, I felt nervous, excited, and a little scared, especially when I saw so many people gathered at the starting line. The atmosphere was incredible: music, encouragement, and a spirit of camaraderie that quickly spread. During the race, people cheered on the participants with shouts, applause, and chants, which gave you an extra push in moments of greater physical and mental exhaustion. Upon crossing the finish line, the feeling of achievement, pride, and happiness was immense, an experience I definitely recommend to everyone looking for a personal challenge.

text_es: For your first popular race, the focus should be on enjoying the process, the experience, and the vibrant atmosphere. Start your training progressively and steadily, increasing the distance and intensity of your miles little by little. Wear appropriate shoes and comfortable athletic clothing, and ensure good hydration with plenty of juice or water during longer training sessions. It is essential to listen to your body, its signals, and its limits to avoid injuries. During the race, maintain a steady, relaxed, and conversational pace, without wearing yourself out at the start. Hydrate well before, during, and after the event, whether with water or isotonic drinks. Finally, don't worry too much about your time or position; the fact is that your main goal is to finish, enjoy, and be proud of your effort.
text_tgt_raw: Para sua primeira corrida popular, o foco deve ser aproveitar o processo, a experiência e a atmosfera vibrante. Comece seu treinamento de forma progressiva e constante, aumentando a distância e a intensidade dos quilômetros pouco a pouco. Use tênis apropriados e roupas confortáveis para o esporte, além de garantir uma boa hidratação com bastante suco ou água durante os treinos mais longos. É fundamental escutar seu corpo, seus sinais e limites para evitar lesões. Durante a corrida, mantenha um ritmo estável, relaxado e conversável, sem se desgastar no início. Hidrate-se bem antes, durante e depois do evento, seja com água ou bebidas isotônicas. Por fim, não se preocupe demais com o tempo ou a posição; o fato é que seu objetivo principal é terminar, desfrutar e sentir orgulho do seu esforço.
base_en: For your 1st popular race, focus on enjoying the process, the experience, and the atmosphere. Start training progressively, gradually, and constantly, increasing distance and intensity little by little. Make sure to wear adequate footwear, comfortable, and breathable clothing, and sufficient hydration during long training sessions. It's vital that you listen to your body, its signals, and its limits to avoid unnecessary injuries. During the race, maintain a stable, relaxed, and conversational pace, without exhausting yourself at the beginning. Hydrate well before, during, and after the event, with water, isotonic drinks, or natural juices. Finally, don't obsess over time or position; your main goal is to finish, enjoy, and feel proud of your effort.

text_es: Restoring an antique piece of furniture is a rewarding process that revives objects with history, functionality, and aesthetic value. It involves assessing the original condition, identifying the wood—oak, walnut, or mahogany—and planning the intervention steps. The first steps include surface cleaning, disassembling hardware—hinges, handles, and locks—and removing old finishes, such as varnishes, waxes, or paints. Next, structural repair proceeds, which may require gluing joints, replacing damaged parts, or treating the wood against wood-boring insects, moisture, or rot. Sanding is crucial to prepare the surface, using different grits—coarse, medium, and fine—until the desired smoothness is achieved. Finally, a new finish is applied—oil, shellac, or polyurethane—which protects and enhances the natural beauty of the furniture, restoring its original splendor and extending its lifespan. This art demands patience, skill, and respect for the academic and artisanal legacy, transforming something worn into a comfortable and beautiful object again.
text_tgt_raw: Restaurar uma peça de mobiliário antigo é um processo gratificante que revive objetos com história, funcionalidade e valor estético. Envolve avaliar a condição original, identificar a madeira — carvalho, nogueira ou mogno — e planejar as etapas da intervenção. Os primeiros passos incluem a limpeza da superfície, a desmontagem das ferragens — dobradiças, puxadores e fechaduras — e a remoção de acabamentos antigos, como vernizes, ceras ou tintas. Em seguida, procede-se ao reparo estrutural, que pode exigir a colagem de juntas, a substituição de partes danificadas ou o tratamento da madeira contra insetos xilófagos, umidade ou apodrecimento. Lixar é crucial para preparar a superfície, usando diferentes granulações — grossa, média e fina — até atingir a suavidade desejada. Por fim, aplica-se um novo acabamento — óleo, goma-laca ou poliuretano — que protege e realça a beleza natural do móvel, restaurando seu esplendor original e estendendo sua vida útil. Essa arte demanda paciência, habilidade e respeito pelo legado acadêmico e artesanal, transformando algo desgastado em um objeto cômodo e belo novamente.
base_en: Restoring an antique piece of furniture is a rewarding process that revives pieces with history, functionality, and aesthetic value. It involves evaluating the original condition, identifying the wood—oak, walnut, or mahogany—and planning the intervention stages. The 1st steps include surface cleaning, disassembling hardware—hinges, handles, and locks—and removing old finishes, such as varnishes, waxes, or paints. Then, structural repair proceeds, which may require gluing joints, replacing damaged parts, or treating the wood against wood-boring insects, humidity, or rot. Sanding is crucial to prepare the surface, using different grits—coarse, medium, and fine—until the desired smoothness is achieved. Finally, a new finish—oil, shellac, or polyurethane—is applied, which protects and enhances the natural beauty of the furniture, restoring its original splendor and extending its useful life. This art requires patience, skill, and respect for the artisanal legacy.

text_es: I decided to restore an old piece of furniture, a dark, solid wood dresser, that was forgotten in the pantry. It had been stored for 20 years, accumulating dust, moisture, and even some insects, waiting for a new life. I started by carefully sanding the surface to remove the damaged varnish, dirt, and imperfections from time. Then, I applied a specific product to treat the wood, protect it, and nourish it deeply. The fact is, it was a laborious, gratifying, and very hands-on process that allowed me to disconnect from the daily hustle and bustle. After several layers of primer, paint, and wax, the furniture regained its original beauty, a warm and vibrant tone. Now it looks splendid in the living room, an object with history, character, and soul that everyone admires, and the best part is that it was economical, without needing to rent expensive tools. Furthermore, I was able to listen to my favorite music on my cell phone while I worked, which made the task even more enjoyable.
text_tgt_raw: Decidi restaurar um móvel antigo, uma cômoda de madeira maciça, escura, que estava esquecida na despensa. Ela ficou guardada por 20 anos, acumulando poeira, umidade e até alguns insetos, esperando por uma nova vida. Comecei lixando a superfície com cuidado para remover o verniz danificado, a sujeira e as imperfeições do tempo. Depois, apliquei um produto específico para tratar a madeira, protegê-la e nutri-la profundamente. O fato é que foi um processo trabalhoso, gratificante e muito manual, que me permitiu desconectar da correria do dia a dia. Após várias camadas de primer, tinta e cera, o móvel recuperou sua beleza original, um tom quente e vibrante. Agora ela está esplêndida na sala de estar, um objeto com história, caráter e alma que todos admiram, e o melhor é que foi econômico, sem precisar de aluguel de ferramentas caras. Além disso, pude ouvir minhas músicas favoritas no celular enquanto trabalhava, o que tornou a tarefa ainda mais prazerosa.
base_en: I decided to restore an antique piece of furniture, an old solid wood dresser, dark, and forgotten in the storage room. It had been stored for 20 years, accumulating dust, moisture, and the occasional bug, waiting for a new life. I started by gently sanding the surface to remove the damaged varnish, dirt, and imperfections of time. Then, I applied a specific product to treat the wood, protect it, and nourish it deeply. The truth is that it was a laborious, gratifying, and very manual process, which allowed me to disconnect from the daily hustle and bustle. After several layers of primer, paint, and wax, the furniture recovered its original beauty, a warm and vibrant tone. Now it looks splendid in the living room, an object with history, character, and soul that everyone admires.

text_es: To successfully restore an antique piece of furniture, especially if it's your first time, patience, dedication, and good planning are essential. Always start by cleaning the surface to remove dust, dirt, and cobwebs, using gentle products, a cloth, or a brush. Next, assess the condition of the wood, hardware, and varnish to decide the type of intervention needed: repair, polishing, or repainting. It's a fact that identifying termites, moisture, or structural breaks will determine the materials and techniques to be used. Before sanding or stripping, protect delicate areas, glass, and upholstery. Research the style, era, and wood of the furniture to choose appropriate products, finishes, and colors. Finally, enjoy the process, learn at each step, and always have basic tools or specific products on hand for any unforeseen circumstances, such as a reference file or a cup of coffee for a break.
text_tgt_raw: Para restaurar com sucesso um móvel antigo, especialmente se for sua primeira vez, paciência, dedicação e um bom planejamento são essenciais. Comece sempre com uma limpeza da superfície para remover poeira, sujeira e teias de aranha, usando produtos suaves, um pano ou uma escova. Em seguida, avalie a condição da madeira, ferragens e verniz para decidir o tipo de intervenção necessária: reparo, polimento ou repintura. É um fato que identificar cupins, umidade ou quebras estruturais determinará os materiais e técnicas a serem usados. Antes de lixar ou decapar, proteja áreas delicadas, vidros e estofamentos. Pesquise o estilo, a época e a madeira do móvel para escolher os produtos, acabamentos e cores adequados. Por fim, aproveite o processo, aprenda a cada etapa e tenha sempre utensílios básicos ou produtos específicos à mão para qualquer imprevisto, como um arquivo de referências ou uma xícara de café para uma pausa.
base_en: To successfully restore an antique piece of furniture—especially if it's your 1st time—patience, dedication, and method are key. Always start with a good surface cleaning to remove dust, dirt, and cobwebs, using gentle products, a cloth, or a brush. Then, evaluate the condition of the wood, hardware, and varnish to decide what type of intervention it needs: repair, polishing, or repainting. It's essential to identify if there are woodworms, moisture, or structural breaks, which will determine the materials, tools, and techniques to use. Before sanding or stripping, protect delicate areas, glass, and upholstery. Research the style, era, and wood of the furniture to choose the appropriate products, finishes, and colors. Finally, enjoy the process, learn from each step, and always have basic utensils, spare parts, or specific products on hand for any unforeseen event.

text_es: Organizing a birthday party requires planning, dedication, and creativity, in addition to good management so that everything goes as expected. First, it's crucial to define the date, time, and location – whether at home, a restaurant, or a hall – and then send out the invitations. It's essential to establish an economical budget for food, drinks, and decorations, adjusting it to financial possibilities and avoiding unnecessary expenses. A guest list should be prepared, taking into account their preferences and possible restrictions, such as allergies. For entertainment, it's good to plan games, music, or activities that liven up the atmosphere, such as karaoke or dancing. Food and drinks are essential; snacks, main courses, and desserts, like cake and ice cream, can be offered, ensuring options for all tastes. An important fact is that the decoration, atmosphere, and small details, such as party favors or photos, are what will make the celebration a memorable and unique event for the birthday person and their guests. Even planning transportation, such as a bus to take guests, can be a good idea.
text_tgt_raw: Organizar uma festa de aniversário exige planejamento, dedicação e criatividade, além de um bom controle para que tudo saia conforme o esperado. Primeiramente, é crucial definir a data, hora e local – seja em casa, restaurante ou salão – para então enviar os convites. É fundamental estabelecer um orçamento econômico para comida, bebida e decoração, ajustando-o às possibilidades financeiras e evitando gastos desnecessários. Uma lista de convidados deve ser preparada, levando em conta suas preferências e possíveis restrições, como alergias. Para a diversão, é interessante planejar jogos, música ou atividades que animem o ambiente, como karaokê ou danças. Comida e bebida são essenciais; podem ser oferecidos salgadinhos, pratos principais e sobremesas, como bolo e sorvete, garantindo opções para todos os gostos. Um fato importante é que a decoração, o clima e os pequenos detalhes, como lembrancinhas ou fotos, são o que tornarão a celebração um evento memorável e único para o aniversariante e seus convidados. Até mesmo planejar o transporte, como um ônibus para levar os convidados, pode ser uma boa ideia.
base_en: Organizing a birthday party requires planning, dedication, and creativity. 1st, you have to define the date, time, and place—home, restaurant, or venue—to send out the invitations. It's essential to establish a budget for food, drinks, and decorations—balloons, garlands, and tablecloths—adjusting to financial possibilities. A guest list should be prepared considering their preferences, ages, and possible allergies. For fun, it's advisable to think about games, music, or activities—karaoke, dances, or contests—that will liven up the atmosphere and appeal to everyone. Food and drinks are key; appetizers, main courses, and desserts—cakes, cookies, and various sweets—can be offered, ensuring options for all tastes. Finally, the decoration, atmosphere, and small details—souvenirs, photos, or candles—are what will make the celebration a memorable and unique event for the birthday person and their friends, family, and acquaintances.

text_es: Organizing my brother's birthday party was a stressful, fun, and rewarding experience. I spent three weeks planning every detail, from the music, food, and drinks, to the decorations, games, and invitations. I had twelve guests on the list and wanted everything to be perfect, so I looked for ideas on Pinterest, YouTube, and Instagram. Preparing the cake was a challenge – I used flour, eggs, and sugar – but in the end it was delicious, a fact that made me very happy. On the day of the party, balloons, streamers, and the piñata filled the room, creating a festive atmosphere. For the special breakfast the next day, we bought pineapple ice cream that he loves. Everyone ate, danced, and laughed a lot, celebrating with joy, affection, and friendship. I remember the sparkle in my brother's eyes when he saw all his friends and family gathered, and that made all the effort worthwhile, in an economical and unforgettable way.
text_tgt_raw: Organizar a festa de aniversário do meu irmão foi uma experiência estressante, divertida e recompensadora. Passei três semanas planejando cada detalhe, desde a música, a comida e as bebidas, até as decorações, os jogos e os convites. Eu tinha doze convidados na lista e queria que tudo fosse perfeito, então procurei ideias no Pinterest, YouTube e Instagram. Preparar o bolo foi um desafio – usei farinha, ovos e açúcar – mas no final ficou delicioso, um fato que me deixou muito feliz. No dia da festa, os balões, serpentinas e a piñata encheram o cômodo, criando uma atmosfera festiva. Para o café da manhã especial do dia seguinte, compramos um sorvete de abacaxi que ele adora. Todos comeram, dançaram e riram muito, celebrando com alegria, carinho e amizade. Lembro-me do brilho nos olhos do meu irmão quando ele viu todos os amigos e familiares reunidos, e isso fez todo o esforço valer a pena, de forma econômica e inesquecível.
base_en: Organizing a birthday party for my brother was a stressful, fun, and rewarding experience. I spent 3 weeks planning every detail, from the music, food, and drinks, to the decorations, games, and invitations. I had 12 guests on the list, and I wanted everything to be perfect, so I looked for ideas on Pinterest, YouTube, and Instagram. Preparing the cake was a challenge—I used flour, eggs, and sugar—but in the end it was delicious. On the day of the party, the balloons, streamers, and piñata filled the room, creating a festive atmosphere. Everyone ate, danced, and laughed a lot, celebrating with joy, affection, and friendship. I remember the sparkle in my brother's eyes when he saw all his friends and family together, and that made all the effort worthwhile, honestly.

text_es: To organize an unforgettable birthday party, planning is the most important factor. Start by defining the budget and date, as well as preparing the guest list. Think of a theme, colors, and decorations that create a festive and personal atmosphere; you can use balloons, garlands, or confetti. Food is another crucial point: will you cook, hire a caterer, or ask guests to bring something? Consider variety, possible allergies, and drinks. Choose an appropriate venue—it could be your home, a garden, or an event hall—making sure there is comfortable space for everyone. For entertainment, don't forget music, games, and activities for children and adults; a show or a sports match can liven things up even more. Finally, confirm attendance, prepare the invitations, and the last details so you can relax and enjoy the event with your loved ones, perhaps even having some good juice or ice cream.
text_tgt_raw: Para organizar uma festa de aniversário inesquecível, o planejamento é o fato mais importante. Comece definindo o orçamento e a data, além de preparar a lista de convidados. Pense em um tema, cores e decorações que criem uma atmosfera festiva e pessoal; você pode usar balões, guirlandas ou confetes. A comida é outro ponto crucial: você vai cozinhar, contratar um bufê ou pedir para os convidados levarem algo? Considere a variedade, possíveis alergias e as bebidas. Escolha um local apropriado — pode ser sua casa, um jardim ou um salão de eventos —, certificando-se de que haja espaço cômodo para todos. Para o entretenimento, não se esqueça da música, dos jogos e das atividades para crianças e adultos; um show ou uma partida de esporte podem animar ainda mais. Por fim, confirme a presença, prepare os convites e os últimos detalhes para poder relaxar e aproveitar o evento com seus entes queridos, quem sabe até tomando um bom suco ou sorvete.
base_en: To organize a memorable birthday party, start by planning the budget, the date, and the guest list. Define the theme, colors, and decorations, choosing among balloons, garlands, and confetti to create a festive and personal atmosphere. Decide whether you'll prepare the food yourself, hire a caterer, or ask guests to bring something, thinking about variety, allergies, and drinks. It's crucial to select a suitable venue—it can be your house, a garden, or an event hall—and make sure there's enough space for everyone. Don't forget the music, games, and activities for children, adults, or both, ensuring entertainment and fun. Finally, confirm attendance, prepare the invitations and details, and relax to enjoy the event with your friends, family, and loved ones.

text_es: Since I moved into this third-floor apartment, with plenty of light, my hobby of caring for houseplants has grown exponentially, transforming my living room into a small jungle. At first, I was a disaster with orchids, pothos, and ficuses; I watered them too much, too little, or at the wrong time, and the poor things suffered. I learned to observe the signs they gave me, such as yellowed, wilted, or spotted leaves, and to adjust my care. Now, I enjoy the routine of checking the substrate's humidity, wiping dust from their leaves, and even talking to them, as if they were pets.
